AI.abstract_zh: 基态制备、能量估计和性质估计是量子模拟中的基本任务。现有基态制备算法利用块编码或受控哈密顿量演化达到近最优复杂度，这引出一个自然的问题：受控哈密顿量演化是否必要，或者能否在仅提供非受控哈密顿量演化的更弱访问模型中达到相同的标度？我们通过给出两种仅通过查询 $U_H$ 及其逆 $U_H^\dagger$ 来访问输入哈密顿量 $H$ 的算法解决了这一问题，其中 $\|H\|\leα_H$ 且 $τ=Θ(1/α_H)$。给定一个基态权重至少为 $η$ 的输入态，以及 $H$ 的谱隙至少为 $γ$，我们的第一个算法使用输入态的新鲜副本，并需要 $\widetilde O(α_H/(γη))$ 次对 $U_H$ 和 $U_H^\dagger$ 的查询，而我们的第二个算法使用对输入态制备酉及其逆的相干访问，将此复杂度改进为 $\widetilde O(α_H/(γ\sqrtη))$。后一个界在对数因子内与已知下界匹配，表明额外具有受控哈密顿量演化访问权的算法无法将基态制备的查询复杂度改进超过对数因子。两种算法均基于我们称为谱下降原理的简单机制，其中算法从输入态 $|ψ\rangle$ 开始，逐步沿能谱下降，越来越接近基态，直到达到所需保真度。我们还将此框架扩展到基态性质和能量估计，并为这两个任务给出显式的复杂度保证。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出仅通过非受控哈密顿量演化访问的谱下降框架，并给出SD与CSD两种基态制备算法；其中CSD在对数因子内匹配已知基态制备下界，表明受控哈密顿量演化对于达到近最优标度并非必要。该框架在文中所述测量或可观测访问假设下扩展到能量估计与基态性质估计：能量估计仅在相位估计步骤使用受控演化，基态性质估计的联合复杂度最优性尚未确定，属于开放问题。上述结论限于论文设定的访问模型、谱隙和基态权重等参数条件。
innovations: 提出谱下降原理，作为仅使用非受控哈密顿量演化进行基态制备的通用框架。
给出SD和CSD两种算法；CSD的查询复杂度 $\widetilde O(α_H/(γ\sqrtη))$ 在对数因子内匹配已知下界。
将框架扩展到基态性质估计和能量估计，并在所述访问假设下给出显式复杂度保证。

title: First-quantized quantum simulation with non-local potentials by matrix-product-state encoding
summary: Quantum simulations based on first-quantized approaches can offer lower space and gate complexities than second-quantized approaches. The gate requirements for these simulations can be further reduced by employing pseudopotentials, a technique widely used in classical quantum chemistry calculations to decrease the number of simulated electrons. However, implementing pseudopotentials in quantum circuits remains challenging due to their non-local nature. In this study, we proposed a method to efficiently implement non-local potentials using matrix product state (MPS) encoding. MPS encoding allows us to efficiently implement a Trotter step operator with a circuit depth of $O(\mathrm{deg}(V_{\mathrm{loc}}) n^{\mathrm{deg}(V_{\mathrm{loc}})} + 8Lnn_{\mathrm{atom}}χ^2 + 2n^2)$, where $\mathrm{deg}(V_{\mathrm{loc}})$ is the degree of the polynomial local potential, $n_{\mathrm{atom}}$ is the number of atoms in the system, $L$ is the maximum number of projector functions across all atoms, and $n$ is the number of qubits used to represent the binary-encoded wave function in one-dimensional space. We demonstrated the effectiveness of this approach by applying it to a model of the ionization of a one-dimensional hydrogen atom driven by an ultrashort laser pulse. Our results showed that MPS encoding significantly reduces the required circuit depth compared to a direct unitary decomposition, providing a pathway for practical first-quantized simulations.

AI.abstract_zh: 基于第一量子化方法的量子模拟可以比第二量子化方法提供更低的空间复杂度和门复杂度。通过采用赝势，这些模拟的门需求可以进一步降低；赝势是经典量子化学计算中广泛使用的技术，用于减少所模拟的电子数。然而，由于其非局域性质，在量子线路中实现赝势仍然具有挑战性。在本研究中，我们提出了一种利用矩阵乘积态（MPS）编码高效实现非局域势的方法。MPS编码允许我们高效实现一个Trotter步算子，其电路深度为$O(\mathrm{deg}(V_{\mathrm{loc}}) n^{\mathrm{deg}(V_{\mathrm{loc}})} + 8Lnn_{\mathrm{atom}}\chi^2 + 2n^2)$，其中$\mathrm{deg}(V_{\mathrm{loc}})$是多项式局域势的次数，$n_{\mathrm{atom}}$是系统中的原子数，$L$是所有原子上投影函数的最大数量，$n$是在一维空间中用于表示二进制编码波函数的量子比特数。我们通过将该方法应用于由超短激光脉冲驱动的一维氢原子电离模型，证明了该方法的有效性。我们的结果表明，与直接幺正分解相比，MPS编码显著降低了所需电路深度，为实际的第一量子化模拟提供了一条途径。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出并在一维氢原子超短激光脉冲电离模型中演示了一种基于MPS编码的第一量子化量子模拟方法，用于高效表示和实现非局域势；作者报告单Trotter步电路深度为$O(\deg(V_{\mathrm{loc}})n^{\deg(V_{\mathrm{loc}})}+8Lnn_{\mathrm{atom}}\chi^{2}+2n^{2})$，MPS最大键维数饱和为8且与网格量子比特数无关，并在$n=7$时将该类Trotter步深度降至直接幺正分解的8%以下。作者认为该方法可推广到三维多电子系统，但现有材料仅演示了一维单电子情形，尚未独立验证。
innovations: 提出用矩阵乘积态（MPS）编码表示第一量子化量子模拟中的非局域势，并将其直接映射为量子线路。
给出一阶Trotter化下单步算子的电路深度上界$O(\deg(V_{\mathrm{loc}})n^{\deg(V_{\mathrm{loc}})}+8Lnn_{\mathrm{atom}}\chi^{2}+2n^{2})$。
在一维氢原子超短激光脉冲电离模型中演示MPS最大键维数饱和为8，且$n=7$时线路深度低于直接幺正分解的8%。

title: Good Quantum Locally Testable Codes from Lossless Cubical Complexes
summary:
Sipser and Spielman constructed LDPC codes from either bipartite \emph{spectral} expanders or one-sided \emph{lossless} expanders. In higher dimensions, \emph{spectral} expansion similarly played a central role in the constructions of asymptotically good classical LTCs and qLDPC codes by Dinur, Evra, Livne, Lubotzky, and Mozes and by Panteleev and Kalachev. Alternatively, Lin and Hsieh constructed classical LTCs and qLDPC codes from two-dimensional \emph{lossless} cubical complexes.
  In this work we develop the higher-dimensional \emph{lossless} approach. We do not construct the required high-dimensional lossless cubical complexes; rather, we investigate what their existence would imply. We associate with a high-dimensional cubical complex a \emph{level chain complex}, whose chain groups are supported on the level sets of the Boolean cube rather than on its cells. Our main technical contribution is a clean local-to-global theorem for this structure: suitable one-dimensional lossless expansion in the directional graphs implies small-set coboundary expansion of the global level complex. As a consequence, sufficiently imbalanced, two-sided lossless four-dimensional cubical complexes give rise to asymptotically good quantum locally testable codes. We expect the local-to-global principle developed here to have further applications.

AI.abstract_zh:
Sipser 和 Spielman 利用二部谱扩张子或单侧无损扩张子构造了 LDPC 码。在高维情形，谱扩张同样在 Dinur、Evra、Livne、Lubotzky 和 Mozes 以及 Panteleev 和 Kalachev 对渐近好经典 LTC 与 qLDPC 码的构造中发挥了核心作用。另一方面，Lin 和 Hsieh 从二维无损立方复形构造了经典 LTC 与 qLDPC 码。
在本工作中，我们发展了高维无损方法。我们并不构造所需的高维无损立方复形；而是研究它们的存在会蕴含什么。我们将一个层级链复形与高维立方复形相关联，其链群支撑在布尔立方体的层级集上，而不是支撑在其胞腔上。我们的主要技术贡献是为该结构给出一个简洁的局部到全局定理：方向图中的适当一维无损扩张蕴含全局层级复形的小集合余边界扩张。作为推论，足够不平衡的双侧无损四维立方复形产生渐近好的量子局部可测试码。我们预期这里发展的局部到全局原理会有进一步应用。
AI.conclusion: 作者发展了高维无损方法，但并未构造所需的高维无损立方复形，而是分析其存在性所蕴含的结论；其局部到全局定理表明，方向图中适当的一维无损扩张可推出全局层级复形的小集合余边界扩张，并由此得到条件性结果：足够不平衡的双侧无损四维立方复形会产生渐近好的量子局部可测试码。该结论的适用范围依赖于相应高维无损立方复形的存在性。
innovations: 发展高维无损方法，研究所需高维无损立方复形存在性所蕴含的结论。
将层级链复形与高维立方复形关联，其链群支撑于布尔立方体的层级集而非胞腔。
建立局部到全局定理：方向图中适当的一维无损扩张蕴含全局层级复形的小集合余边界扩张，并由此给出渐近好量子局部可测试码的推论。

title: Polynomial-time local-unitary equivalence of graph states
summary: Local-unitary (LU) equivalence asks whether two quantum states differ only by independent changes of basis on their qubits. For graph states, whether this relation can be decided in polynomial time has remained open for over a decade. We give a deterministic algorithm that decides LU equivalence for graphs on $n$ labelled vertices in $\widetilde O(n^{6.38})$ bit operations and constructs exact single-qubit unitaries whenever the states are equivalent. Building on Claudet and Perdrix's quasipolynomial algorithm, we replace the enumeration of vertex subsets by a compact system of constraints generated from pairs and triples. The remaining graph transformation is found by solving linear equations over the binary field. These new steps cost $\widetilde O(n^5)$ bit operations; the inherited graph preprocessing sets the overall bound. We also count the local-Clifford (LC) classes of graph states within any LU class: their number is a power of two, computable within the same bound. For any given graph state, this decides whether single-qubit Clifford gates reach every graph state in its LU class, and supplies a counterexample when they do not. The method also decides LU equivalence of stabilizer codes encoding one logical qubit.

AI.abstract_zh: 局部酉（LU）等价问的是两个量子态是否仅相差其量子比特上各自独立的基变换。对于图态，这一关系能否在多项式时间内判定已悬而未决十余年。我们给出一个确定性算法，在 $\widetilde O(n^{6.38})$ 次比特操作内判定 $n$ 个带标号顶点上的图的 LU 等价性，并在两态等价时构造出精确的单量子比特酉变换。基于 Claudet 和 Perdrix 的准多项式算法，我们用由顶点对和三重组生成的紧凑约束系统替代对顶点子集的枚举。剩余的图变换通过在二元域上求解线性方程得到。这些新步骤花费 $\widetilde O(n^5)$ 次比特操作；继承来的图预处理决定了总体界。我们还计数任意 LU 类内图态的局部 Clifford（LC）类：其数目为 2 的幂，并可在同一界内计算。对任意给定图态，这判定单量子比特 Clifford 门是否可达其 LU 类中的每一个图态，并在不可达时提供一个反例。该方法还判定编码一个逻辑量子比特的稳定子码的 LU 等价性。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出判定图态 LU 等价性的确定性多项式时间算法（总体界为 $\widetilde O(n^{6.38})$ 次比特操作），可构造精确的单量子比特酉变换，并在同一界内计数 LU 类中的 LC 类；对编码一个逻辑量子比特的稳定子码也可判定 LU 等价。其最坏情形指数由继承的标准形步骤决定，新的代数步骤为 $\widetilde O(n^5)$，因此更快的标准形获取方式可改进总界。结论节选同时指出，约 26 个量子比特以内的分量可用普通 LC 检验作为捷径；含多个逻辑量子比特的稳定子码扩展需处理参考系统上的联合作用，实验态还需定义近似表示与保真度要求，这些情形不在现有精确判定范围内。
innovations: 将 Claudet–Perdrix 准多项式算法中对顶点子集的枚举替换为由顶点对和三重组生成的紧凑约束系统。
通过在二元域上求解线性方程来寻找剩余的图变换。
给出计数任意 LU 类内 LC 类的方法（其数目为 2 的幂），并据此判定单量子比特 Clifford 门能否到达该 LU 类中所有图态、不能时给出反例；该方法也判定编码一个逻辑量子比特的稳定子码的 LU 等价性。

title: Quantum Krylov Learning
summary: The Hamiltonian of a natural quantum system is usually determined indirectly, by proposing microscopic models and comparing their predicted observables with experiment. A more direct approach is to extract information about the Hamiltonian from measurements on the system itself. In many settings, however, direct access to the full system is unavailable and measurements can be performed only through controllable probes, as in quantum sensing and boundary spectroscopy. Existing Hamiltonian learning protocols under such restricted access typically require a special symmetry, a known parametric form, or controlled operations beyond free evolution. We introduce Quantum Krylov Learning (QKL), a restricted-access framework that avoids these requirements. QKL uses single temperature probe autocorrelators and their operator Krylov structure to extract model-independent spectral information about the unknown system. Rather than fitting a parametrized Hamiltonian, it reconstructs the operator Krylov Jacobi matrix representing the dynamical modes accessible to the probe. The method assumes that the unobserved system is at, or near, infinite temperature. Under this condition, the Jacobi matrix can be reconstructed directly from the autocorrelation of a probe observable, without oracle access to the Hamiltonian. The required operations are free evolution under the unknown $H$, together with probe state preparation and measurement. The learning core therefore requires no symmetry, no parametric model, and no controlled-unitary gates. We show a Lieb--Robinson bound for the operator Krylov chain and derive a data-driven criterion for the required observation window. We also establish an end-to-end sample complexity guarantee: under generic conditions on the spectral gaps and weights, the number of measurement shots required to achieve spectral precision $\varepsilon$ is polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$.

AI.abstract_zh: 自然量子系统的哈密顿量通常通过提出微观模型并将其预测的可观测量与实验比较来间接确定。更直接的方法是从对系统本身的测量中提取关于哈密顿量的信息。然而在许多情形下，无法直接访问完整系统，只能通过可控探针进行测量，如量子传感和边界光谱学中那样。在此类受限访问下，现有的哈密顿量学习协议通常需要特殊对称性、已知的参数形式，或超出自由演化的受控操作。我们提出量子Krylov学习（Quantum Krylov Learning, QKL），一种避免这些要求的受限访问框架。QKL 使用单温度探针自相关函数及其算符Krylov结构，提取关于未知系统的与模型无关的谱信息。它不拟合参数化哈密顿量，而是重构表示探针可访问动力学模式的算符Krylov雅可比矩阵。该方法假设未观测系统处于或接近无穷高温度。在此条件下，雅可比矩阵可直接由探针可观测量的自相关重构，而无需通过 oracle 访问哈密顿量。所需操作是在未知 $H$ 下的自由演化，以及探针态制备和测量。因此学习核心不需要对称性、不需要参数化模型，也不需要受控幺正门。我们展示了算符Krylov链的Lieb--Robinson界，并推导了所需观测窗口的数据驱动判据。我们还建立了端到端样本复杂度保证：在谱隙和权重的通用条件下，达到谱精度 $\varepsilon$ 所需的测量次数是 $1/\varepsilon$ 的多项式。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出 Quantum Krylov Learning（QKL）作为受限访问下的哈密顿量学习框架：利用单温度量子探针自相关及其算符Krylov结构构造与模型无关的谱数据，并在无穷高温度自相关基础上重构算符Krylov雅可比矩阵。作者报告该方法在无噪声极限下对任意哈密顿量无需对称性假设即可精确重构（定理3），在有限测量次数下于固定谱分辨率给出 poly(1/ε) 的端到端样本复杂度保证（定理4、式(22)），并满足 Lieb–Robinson 界和输运公式，后者给出观测窗口的数据驱动判据。作者指出无穷高温度要求可在 NV 色心和施主自旋平台上自然满足，有限温度误差受控且次主导于有限窗口和测量噪声效应；在 N=6 XXZ 基准上，全数据驱动流程将领先的 oracle 雅可比系数复现到百分之几以内（当前窗口内较高系数为 10–34%），窗口尺度 τ^op 为 0.9–6.6%。适用范围为受限访问、无穷或近无穷温度条件，且结论主要基于作者给出的理论保证与基准测试。
innovations: 提出受限访问下的量子Krylov学习（QKL）框架，无需对称性、参数化模型或受控幺正门。
利用单温度探针自相关及其算符Krylov结构，重构与模型无关的算符Krylov雅可比矩阵。
给出算符Krylov链的Lieb–Robinson界、观测窗口的数据驱动判据，以及达到谱精度 ε 的 poly(1/ε) 端到端样本复杂度保证。

title: Unifying and Extending Strong Simulation of Quantum Circuits
summary:
We establish functional aggregate queries (FAQs) as a unifying language for exact classical simulation of quantum circuits. A circuit becomes a sum-product query: factors encode gates, internal wire variables are aggregated, and free boundary variables index transition amplitudes. The central insight is that distinct sources of simulation tractability can be exploited within the same InsideOut evaluation scheme. The query specifies what is computed; the evaluation plan, semiring, and representation of intermediate factors determine the cost.
  This view unifies structural and algebraic simulation guarantees. With explicit factor representations, FAQ evaluation recovers the treewidth bound for tensor-network contraction and yields finer sparsity-sensitive bounds via fractional covers. Over a formal phase semiring, compressed intermediate factors recover rank-width-based simulation for compatible quadratic phase representations. For Clifford circuits, affine-quadratic factors are closed under multiplication and marginalization and remain polynomial in size, yielding polynomial-time exact amplitude computation without any bounded-width assumption.
  Beyond these recoveries, the framework yields a new tractability criterion: tensor layout symmetry width. This parameter combines local cut-rank with separator symmetry through exact tree-tensor representations. We give a constructive evaluation bound and exhibit a circuit family with bounded tensor layout symmetry width but unbounded phase-graph rank-width and circuit line-graph treewidth. These results establish representation-aware FAQ evaluation as a common algorithmic foundation for classical simulation and a systematic route to new tractable regimes.

AI.abstract_zh:
我们建立函数聚合查询（functional aggregate queries, FAQs）作为量子电路精确经典模拟的统一语言。一个电路变成一个和-积查询：因子编码门，内部线路变量被聚合，自由边界变量索引跃迁振幅。核心洞见是，不同的模拟可处理性来源可以在同一个 InsideOut 评估方案内被利用。查询规定计算什么；评估计划、半环和中间因子的表示决定代价。

这一视角统一了结构与代数模拟保证。借助显式因子表示，FAQ 评估恢复了张量网络收缩的树宽界，并通过分数覆盖产生更精细的稀疏性敏感界。在形式相位半环上，压缩中间因子恢复了针对兼容二次相位表示的基于秩宽的模拟。对于 Clifford 电路，仿射二次因子在乘法和边缘化下封闭且规模保持多项式，从而在没有任何有界宽度假设的情况下得到多项式时间精确振幅计算。

除了这些恢复之外，该框架产生一个新的可处理性判据：张量布局对称宽度（tensor layout symmetry width）。该参数通过精确树张量表示将局部割秩与分隔符对称性结合起来。我们给出一个构造性评估界，并展示一个电路族，其张量布局对称宽度有界，但相位图秩宽和电路线图树宽无界。这些结果确立表示感知的 FAQ 评估作为经典模拟的共同算法基础，以及通往新的可处理区域的系统途径。
AI.conclusion: 作者报告称，同一套 FAQ 形式可用于推导已有和新的精确强模拟结果：显式因子恢复 Markov–Shi 的树宽界并给出更细的稀疏性敏感界；形式相位半环恢复基于秩宽的界且构造更简单；系数张量引入严格推广树宽与秩宽方法的 tlsw，并构造出 tlsw 至多为 2、而相位图 rank-width 与线路线图 treewidth 均无界的电路族；仿射二次因子通过 InsideOut 恢复 Gottesman–Knill 定理的精确振幅推论。适用范围上，秩宽和 tlsw 结果假设二次 r-兼容门集；作者还提出向非二次门集、更快的 AQ 评估、其他因子表示和噪声电路扩展的方向。
innovations: 建立以函数聚合查询（FAQs）为统一语言的精确经典强模拟框架，可在同一 InsideOut 评估方案中利用不同可处理性来源。
提出张量布局对称宽度（tlsw）这一新的可处理性判据，并给出构造性评估上界。
构造出 tlsw 至多为 2、而相位图 rank-width 与线路线图 treewidth 均无界的电路族。

title: A polynomial-time classical sampler for noisy quantum circuits from statistical mechanics
summary: Developing classical simulation algorithms for noisy quantum circuits is essential to delineating the limits of quantum advantage. Existing classical sampling approaches for general circuits require circuit depths to grow logarithmically with system size, so that noise drives the global output state close to a trivial state. Here we show that local accumulation of noise at a depth independent of system size is already sufficient. Specifically, we prove that any geometrically local circuit composed of unital operations and interspersed with single-qubit depolarizing noise of strength $p$ after $Ω(p^{-1} \log p^{-1})$ depth can be approximately sampled from a polynomial-time classical computer. Our proof maps the output state of the circuit to a polymer model in statistical mechanics, and combines a convergent cluster expansion with hypercontractivity of the depolarizing channel.

AI.abstract_zh: 开发针对含噪量子电路的经典模拟算法，对于界定量子优势的极限至关重要。现有的针对一般电路的经典采样方法要求电路深度随系统尺寸对数增长，从而噪声将全局输出态驱动至接近平凡态。这里我们表明，噪声在与系统尺寸无关的深度上的局域累积已经足够。具体而言，我们证明：任何由保单位（unital）操作构成、并穿插强度为 $p$ 的单量子比特去极化噪声的几何局域电路，在深度达到 $Ω(p^{-1} \log p^{-1})$ 后，可以由多项式时间经典计算机近似采样。我们的证明将电路的输出态映射为统计力学中的聚合物模型，并结合收敛的集团展开与去极化信道的超收缩性。
AI.conclusion: 摘要证明：对于由保单位操作构成、并穿插强度为 $p$ 的单量子比特去极化噪声的几何局域电路，当深度达到 $Ω(p^{-1} \log p^{-1})$（与系统尺寸无关）时，可由多项式时间经典计算机近似采样；因此，此类含噪电路的噪声局域累积已足以使其经典可采样，从而界定了相应量子优势的极限。该结论适用于摘要所述的几何局域、保单位操作与单量子比特去极化噪声模型；正文结论章节未提供。
innovations: 证明与系统尺寸无关的噪声深度下，噪声的局域累积已足以实现经典近似采样。
给出几何局域保单位电路在单量子比特去极化噪声下于 $Ω(p^{-1} \log p^{-1})$ 深度后可由多项式时间经典计算机近似采样的结论。
将电路输出态映射为统计力学聚合物模型，并结合收敛集团展开与去极化信道的超收缩性完成证明。

title: Optimal two-mode bosonic loss codes from finite group symmetry
comment: 7-page Letter and 65-page Supplemental Material; 3 main figures and 28 supplementary figures
summary: Photon loss is a dominant noise process in bosonic quantum hardware, including superconducting cavities. Fixed-total-photon-number qubit encodings in two bosonic modes retain the loss-detection advantage of dual-rail qubits while supporting photon loss correction. Optimizing entanglement fidelity in this setting for $4\leq n\leq25$ over arbitrary encoders and decoders reveals finite-group structure in every best-found code: 11 correspond to two-dimensional irreducible representations and 11 to reducible ones. Motivated by this emergence, we derive the necessary-and-sufficient Knill-Laflamme conditions for arbitrary finite-group-invariant codes, reducing their construction to equations on representation multiplicity spaces. For every finite subgroup of $SU(2)$ and every tensor rank, we explicitly construct the minimum number of operators required to impose all corresponding loss-correction constraints. These results produce analytic counterparts to most numerical codes and predict constructions missed by the initial search. Exact MacWilliams-Farkas certificates show that our codes achieve the maximum possible loss distance in 21 of the 22 sectors, and we prove that the resulting distance bound is monotone in total photon number. Beyond the scan, we identify a binary-polyhedral sequence with photon number $n_d=\lceil(3d^2+1)/4\rceil$ and construct each corresponding code through distance $d=10$. To our knowledge, the constructed $(n,d)=(28,6),(49,8),(76,10)$ codes give the smallest reported $n$ for their respective distances; all members through $d=9$ attain the fixed-$n$ LP distance bound. Together, these constructions, certificates, and a symmetry-reduced constraint count provide evidence for an infinite code family conjectured to attain every distance at the minimum photon number.

AI.abstract_zh: 光子损耗是玻色量子硬件（包括超导腔）中的主导噪声过程。两个玻色模式中的固定总光子数量子比特编码保留了双轨量子比特的损耗检测优势，同时支持光子损耗校正。在该设置下，对 $4\leq n\leq25$ 范围在任意编码器和解码器上优化纠缠保真度，揭示出每个找到的最佳编码都具有有限群结构：11 个对应二维不可约表示，11 个对应可约表示。受这一现象启发，我们推导了任意有限群不变编码的充分必要 Knill-Laflamme 条件，将其构造约化为表示重数空间上的方程。对于 $SU(2)$ 的每个有限子群和每个张量秩，我们显式构造了施加所有相应损耗校正约束所需的最少数量的算符。这些结果为大多数数值编码给出解析对应物，并预测了初始搜索遗漏的构造。精确的 MacWilliams-Farkas 证书表明，我们的编码在 22 个扇区中的 21 个达到最大可能损耗距离，并且我们证明所得距离界关于总光子数单调。在扫描之外，我们识别出一个二元多面体序列，其光子数为 $n_d=\lceil(3d^2+1)/4\rceil$，并构造了直到距离 $d=10$ 的每个相应编码。据我们所知，所构造的 $(n,d)=(28,6),(49,8),(76,10)$ 编码在其各自距离下给出了已报道的最小 $n$；直到 $d=9$ 的所有成员都达到固定 $n$ 的 LP 距离界。总之，这些构造、证书以及对称性约化的约束计数为一个被猜想能在最小光子数下达到每个距离的无限编码族提供了证据。
AI.conclusion: 摘要报告：在两玻色模式的固定总光子数编码中，最佳编码呈现有限群结构；作者据此导出有限群不变编码的充分必要 Knill-Laflamme 条件，并构造相应编码。精确证书显示所构造编码在 22 个扇区中的 21 个达到最大可能损耗距离，距离界关于总光子数单调；构造至 $d=10$ 的二元多面体序列，并报告若干编码在其距离下已报道的最小 $n$。这些结果被作者视为支持一个无限编码族的证据，该族被猜想能在最小光子数下达到每个距离。上述结论仅依据摘要，适用范围为两玻色模式固定总光子数编码及有限群不变编码，未提供正文结论章节。
innovations: 从数值优化中观察最佳编码的有限群结构，并据此推导任意有限群不变编码的充分必要 Knill-Laflamme 条件，将构造约化为表示重数空间上的方程。
对 $SU(2)$ 的每个有限子群和每个张量秩，显式构造施加全部损耗校正约束所需的最少算符数，并给出多数数值编码的解析对应及预测初始搜索遗漏的构造。
识别光子数为 $n_d=\lceil(3d^2+1)/4\rceil$ 的二元多面体序列并构造至 $d=10$，报告 $(n,d)=(28,6),(49,8),(76,10)$ 在其距离下已报道的最小 $n$。

title: Characterizing unitaries via quasi-process functions
summary: It is well-known that every n-qubit unitary can be decomposed into a product of controlled single-qubit unitaries. We show that the control conditions in such a decomposition naturally define a quasi-process function, an object that originally came up in the study of indefinite causal order. Here quasi-process functions yield a representation of every n-qubit unitary in a canonical form, namely, as a quasi-process function unitary (qPFU). We use this representation to show how quantum nonlocality without entanglement (QNLWE) can be understood in terms of unitaries that encode the trade-off between causal order and locality noted in R. Kunjwal and Ä. Baumeler, arXiv:2202.00440. Specifically, we obtain two sufficient (but not necessary) criteria---mutual exclusivity of control conditions (MECC) and Unambiguity---for a unitary to be a process function unitary (PFU), i.e., it admits a qPFU representation where the quasi-process function is a process function, an object that can model paradox-free classical causal loops. We also show the inequivalence of these criteria, neither implying the other. We then show that the circuit depth of MECC unitaries admits a characterization in terms of clique-partitioning problems on Hamming graphs and use this correspondence to provide bounds on the circuit depth of n-qubit MECC unitaries. Finally, we show how MECC unitaries provide a recipe for constructing a unitary purification of the associated process function, thereby providing a large class of unitary processes of interest in quantum causality. The generality of this causality-inspired representation of unitaries makes it a versatile tool for analyzing the structure of quantum circuits in other domains.

AI.abstract_zh: 众所周知，每个 n-量子比特幺正操作都可以分解为受控单量子比特幺正操作的乘积。我们证明，这种分解中的控制条件自然地定义了一个准过程函数（quasi-process function），这一对象最初出现在不定因果序的研究中。在这里，准过程函数给出了每个 n-量子比特幺正操作的一种标准形式表示，即表示为准过程函数幺正操作（qPFU）。我们利用这一表示来展示，如何用编码因果序与局域性之间权衡的幺正操作来理解无纠缠的量子非局域性（QNLWE），这种权衡由 R. Kunjwal 和 Ä. Baumeler, arXiv:2202.00440 指出。具体而言，我们得到两个充分（但不必要）的判据——控制条件的互斥性（MECC）和 Unambiguity（无歧义性）——用于判断一个幺正操作是否为过程函数幺正操作（PFU），即它是否容许一种 qPFU 表示，其中准过程函数是一个过程函数，而过程函数是一种可以对无悖论的经典因果环进行建模的对象。我们还表明这些判据是不等价的，二者互不蕴含。接着，我们表明 MECC 幺正操作的电路深度可以用汉明图上的团划分问题来刻画，并利用这一对应关系给出 n-量子比特 MECC 幺正操作电路深度的界。最后，我们表明 MECC 幺正操作如何提供一种构造相关过程函数的幺正纯化的配方，从而给出一大类在量子因果性中受到关注的幺正过程。这种受因果性启发的幺正表示的一般性，使其成为分析其他领域中量子电路结构的多功能工具。
AI.conclusion: 作者总结说，受 QNLWE 集合与不定因果序之间联系启发而引入的 qPFU 表示，可用于研究将计算基映射到可由过程函数测量的 QNLWE 基的幺正操作结构；他们定义 MECC 幺正类并证明 MECC 是成为 PFU 的充分条件，利用广义汉明图重新表述其构造并获得电路深度的组合洞见；同时证明无歧义性与 MECC 不等价，二者对编码过程函数均充分但非必要；并将从 SHIFT 幺正提取 AF/BW 过程函数的协议推广到任意 MECC 幺正，从而系统生成幺正过程。上述结论主要适用于文中所讨论的幺正/量子电路与确定性不定因果序示例，必要且充分条件等仍留作未来工作。
innovations: 作者提出用准过程函数表示幺正操作（qPFU），并指出每个 n-量子比特幺正操作都可有此规范表示。
作者提出 MECC 与 Unambiguity 两个充分但非必要的 PFU 判据，并证明二者互不蕴含。
作者建立 MECC 幺正电路深度与汉明图团划分问题的联系以给出深度界，并给出构造过程函数幺正纯化的系统方法。

title: Quantum key distribution using generalized contextuality against post-quantum eavesdroppers
summary: Bell nonlocality allows secret key to be certified without trusting the internal operation of the devices, and even against eavesdroppers constrained only by the no-signaling principle. We ask whether generalized contextuality, a notion of nonclassicality available in prepare-and-measure experiments on a single system, can play an analogous role. In our approach, Alice and Bob first establish operational equivalences among their local preparation and measurement procedures, which are then treated as theory-independent constraints that any physical intervention on the communication channel, including that of an adversary, must respect. Eve is otherwise unrestricted, that is, her intervention on the transmitted system is not assumed to be described by quantum theory. Within this adversarial model, we show that Eve's optimal guessing probability against individual attacks is the solution of a finite linear program, and hence that a worst-case asymptotic key rate follows from the observed statistics and the operational equivalences alone. We prove that contextuality is necessary for a positive key rate. However, we also show that it is not sufficient. Concretely, the (3,2)-parity-oblivious random access code, known to yield secret key against a quantum eavesdropper, yields none certifiable key rate against a post-quantum one. Conversely, operational equivalences with no analogue among no-signaling constraints can strictly increase the asymptotic key rate. We illustrate this with the prepare-and-measure version of the standard CHSH protocol with an aligned key-generating setting.

AI.abstract_zh: 贝尔非定域性允许在无需信任设备内部操作的情况下认证密钥，甚至可以针对仅受无信号原理约束的窃听者。我们问：广义语境性——一种在单系统制备-测量实验中可用的非经典性概念——能否扮演类似角色。在我们的方法中，Alice和Bob首先在其本地制备与测量程序之间建立操作等价关系，这些关系随后被视为理论无关的约束，任何对通信信道的物理干预（包括对手的干预）都必须遵守。除此之外，Eve不受限制，也就是说，不假设她对所传输系统的干预可由量子理论描述。在这一对抗模型内，我们证明：Eve针对个体攻击的最优猜测概率是一个有限线性规划的解，因此最坏情况的渐近密钥率仅由观测到的统计数据和操作等价关系即可推出。我们证明语境性对于正密钥率是必要的。然而，我们也表明它并不充分。具体而言，已知在量子窃听者面前能产生秘密密钥的(3,2)-parity-oblivious random access code（PORAC），在面对后量子窃听者时不能产生任何可认证的密钥率。反过来，那些在无信号约束中没有对应物的操作等价关系可以严格提高渐近密钥率。我们用标准CHSH协议的制备-测量版本（其中含一个对齐的密钥生成设置）来说明这一点。
AI.conclusion: 作者表明，广义语境性可在不假设被传输系统或Eve对其干预受量子力学支配的情况下，为制备-测量QKD提供操作基础；其核心是Alice和Bob可信实验室内建立的操作等价关系，这些关系约束观测统计的可容许扩展，从而约束Eve的猜测概率。在该对抗模型中，语境性是正密钥率的必要条件但非充分条件；(3,2)-PORAC对量子对手可给出正密钥率，却对后量子对手无可认证正密钥率，而无无信号对应物的操作等价关系可严格提高认证速率。该分析针对个体攻击，不是通常意义上的设备无关或半设备无关，并依赖本地测试层析完备/无隐藏信道等可证伪假设；一般攻击与可组合安全尚待未来工作。
innovations: 提出一种基于广义语境性的制备-测量QKD框架，在不假设通信系统或窃听者干预服从量子力学的情况下认证密钥率。
证明Eve对个体攻击的最优猜测概率可由有限线性规划求解，且最坏情况渐近密钥率可由观测统计与操作等价关系推出。
证明语境性是正密钥率的必要条件但非充分条件，并用(3,2)-PORAC及无无信号对应物的操作等价关系给出区分性示例。

title: Late-Time Power Laws in Fluorescence Decays: Quantum Decay or Alternative Mechanisms?
summary: In quantum mechanics, the properties of an unstable system are closely related to its corresponding energy distribution. One of the predictions of the theory is the emergence of a late-time power law in the survival probability $P(t)$ of the unstable state. However, in complex systems, similar effects may emerge due to other phenomena. This is the case for nonextensive statistical models, for some continuous lifetime distribution models, and also for certain energy-migration models applied to fluorescence. In this work, these alternative interpretations are confronted with data from time-resolved fluorescence spectroscopy experiments with erythrosine B and eosine Y as fluorophores. It turns out that some of the features expected within the quantum-mechanical description, such as the sharp transition from the exponential to the power-law regime, cannot be reproduced by the specific statistical and energy-migration parametrizations fitted in the analysis.

AI.abstract_zh: 在量子力学中，一个不稳定系统的性质与其对应的能量分布密切相关。该理论的一项预言是，不稳定态的存活概率 $P(t)$ 在晚期会出现幂律。然而，在复杂系统中，类似效应可能由其他现象产生。非广延统计模型、某些连续寿命分布模型，以及应用于荧光的某些能量迁移模型就是这种情况。在这项工作中，将这些替代解释与以赤藓红B和曙红Y为荧光团的时间分辨荧光光谱实验数据进行了对照。结果表明，量子力学描述中预期的一些特征，例如从指数区制到幂律区制的陡峭转变，无法由分析中拟合的特定统计与能量迁移参数化再现。
AI.conclusion: 对赤藓红B和曙红Y的荧光衰减数据可由量子力学模型很好地描述，这些模型给出晚期依赖能带的幂律行为；但该解释并非唯一可能，其他机制也可能导致幂律或准幂律行为。本文分析表明，所拟合的特定统计与能量迁移参数化不能重现实验数据中观测到的从指数区制到幂律区制的相对陡峭转变。二阶延迟荧光过程原则上可产生这种交叉，但本文考虑的单发射布居、发射谱不随时间变化的简单延迟荧光模型不能解释观测到的能带依赖性。结果进一步支持将观测到的晚期偏离解释为非指数量子衰减的表现，并计划进一步测量检验这一解释。
innovations: 将非广延统计、连续寿命分布和能量迁移等替代机制与赤藓红B/曙红Y时间分辨荧光数据直接对照。
指出所拟合的特定统计与能量迁移参数化无法重现实验观测到的从指数区制到幂律区制的较陡转变。

title: Engineering non-ergodic properties in two dimensional quantum many-body systems
summary: Non-ergodic quantum many-body dynamics offers a route to persistent quantum coherence far from equilibrium, beyond the conventional expectations of thermalizing statistical mechanics. Most known examples have been identified through intuition, analogy, or numerical search, rather than by systematic Hamiltonian design. This leaves few general methods for engineering robust non-ergodic dynamics in disorder-free interacting quantum many-body systems, especially in higher dimensions where enhanced connectivity generally disfavors ergodicity breaking. Here, we use an eigenstate-to-Hamiltonian construction approach to systematically engineer two-dimensional quantum spin Hamiltonians with tunable non-ergodic properties. Starting from a common parent model and input eigenstate, we construct two target Hamiltonians on the square lattice that differ in their interaction geometry: axial versus diagonal. We show that the resulting interaction geometry and coupling pattern control the Hilbert-space structure and dynamics. The axial model forms a connected Hilbert-space network and exhibits an anisotropy-driven crossover from ergodic to non-ergodic behavior through the suppression of resonances. In contrast, the diagonal model exhibits Hilbert-space fragmentation and, within its largest irreducible sector, signatures of quantum many-body scar dynamics including towers of highly localized, low-entanglement eigenstates, and long-lived coherent revivals. These results establish a direct link between Hamiltonian design, Hilbert-space network structure, and emergent non-ergodic dynamics.

AI.abstract_zh: 非遍历量子多体动力学为在远离平衡时实现持续量子相干性提供了一条途径，超越了热化统计力学的传统预期。大多数已知例子是通过直觉、类比或数值搜索识别出来的，而不是通过系统的哈密顿量设计。这导致在无无序的相互作用量子多体系统中，尤其是在增强连通性通常不利于遍历性破缺的高维情形下，很少有通用方法来工程化稳健的非遍历动力学。这里，我们使用本征态到哈密顿量构造方法，系统地工程化具有可调非遍历性质的二维量子自旋哈密顿量。从共同的母模型和输入本征态出发，我们在方格子上构造了两个目标哈密顿量，它们的相互作用几何不同：轴向与对角。我们表明，由此产生的相互作用几何和耦合模式控制希尔伯特空间结构和动力学。轴向模型形成一个连通的希尔伯特空间网络，并通过抑制共振表现出由各向异性驱动的从遍历到非遍历行为的交叉。相反，对角模型表现出希尔伯特空间碎片化，并在其最大的不可约扇区内表现出量子多体疤痕动力学的特征，包括高度局域化、低纠缠本征态的塔状结构，以及长寿命的相干复兴。这些结果建立了哈密顿量设计、希尔伯特空间网络结构和涌现非遍历动力学之间的直接联系。
AI.conclusion: 作者将本征态到哈密顿量构造确立为在二维量子系统中工程化可调非遍历动力学的系统途径。由同一输入态但不同相互作用几何构造的 \tilde{H}_{\mathrm{axial}} 与 \tilde{H}_{\mathrm{diag}} 显示：轴向模型保持连通但各向异性抑制共振，驱动从遍历到强非遍历的交叉；对角模型则通过希尔伯特空间碎片化与结构化共振稳定塔状低纠缠、高IPR本征态，并产生稳健可调保真度复兴。该结论限于所构造的无无序二维方格自旋模型及所用诊断，作者仅将其视为面向可编程量子模拟器的蓝图，未报告实验验证。
innovations: 提出并演示用本征态到哈密顿量构造（EHC）从同一母模型和输入本征态系统设计二维方格自旋哈密顿量，以调控非遍历性质。
通过轴向与对角两种相互作用几何，展示相互作用几何和耦合模式可控制希尔伯特空间网络结构及动力学。
在对角模型中识别出希尔伯特空间碎片化及塔状低纠缠本征态和长寿命相干复兴等量子多体疤痕特征。

title: Operator-language Feynman rules for driven-dissipative quantum systems: from mean field to non-Gaussian photon correlations
summary: We construct Feynman rules for Lindblad master equations in the operator language of quantum optics: a fixed algebra of elementary operator moves and closed-form propagators for perturbation theory about an exactly solvable, in most cases Gaussian, generator. The expansion separates into a kinematic part (the shift algebra on the Wick-ordered eigenoperators $O_{mn}=:(c^\dagger)^m c^n:$, from which the vertex table for a specified interaction is assembled) and a dynamical part that enters only through the resolvent of the unperturbed generator, diagonal and additive for any stable, diagonalizable Gaussian $L_0$, including thermal and squeezed reservoirs and correlated decay, and equally available for a two-level emitter, driven or undriven. In the driven Kerr cavity the loop expansion is the semiclassical expansion and the series is asymptotic. In a strongly driven two-level atom, dressed lines replace a series of finite radius by one accurate deep into saturation, one line per Mollow component. For Kerr rings and chains the cost is polynomial in the number of sites at fixed perturbative order. On a three-site ring the diagrams recover the non-Gaussian part of the three-photon correlation that the Gaussian cumulant closure lacks; carried to tenth order they give the smallest $g^{(3)}$ error of the methods compared for $U\leq0.25κ$ at a cost below that of a fourth-order closure, and third- and fourth-order closures are more accurate at moderate coupling. The same rules, extended to the counting-field-tilted generator, give the photon-counting cumulants of a disordered eight-site chain beyond direct diagonalization; quantum-jump trajectories at three couplings agree with them to within $1.6$ standard errors, within one at the strongest coupling, where they place the third cumulant six standard errors above the Gaussian value.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们用量子光学的算符语言为 Lindblad 主方程构造 Feynman 规则：一组固定的基本算符移动代数，以及围绕一个精确可解、多数情形下为高斯型的生成元的微扰论的闭式传播子。该展开分为运动学部分（Wick 序本征算符 $O_{mn}=:(c^\dagger)^m c^n:$ 上的位移代数，指定相互作用的顶点表由此组装）和动力学部分；后者仅通过未微扰生成元的预解式进入，对任意稳定、可对角化的高斯型 $L_0$ 是对角且可加的，包括热库和压缩库以及相关衰减，并且同样适用于被驱动或未被驱动的二能级发射体。在被驱动的 Kerr 腔中，圈展开就是半经典展开，且该级数为渐近级数。在强驱动二能级原子中，缀饰线将有限收敛半径的级数替换为一个在深进入饱和区仍准确的级数，每个 Mollow 分量对应一条线。对于 Kerr 环和链，在固定微扰阶数下代价随格点数呈多项式增长。在三格点环上，这些图恢复了高斯累积量闭合所缺失的三光子关联的非高斯部分；推进到十阶时，对于 $U≤0.25κ$，它们给出所比较方法中最小的 $g^{(3)}$ 误差，且代价低于四阶闭合，而在中等耦合下三阶和四阶闭合更准确。相同的规则推广到计数场倾斜的生成元后，可给出无序八格点链的光子计数累积量，超越直接对角化；三个耦合下的量子跳跃轨迹与这些结果在 $1.6$ 个标准误以内一致，在最强耦合下在 $1$ 个标准误以内一致，在那里它们将第三累积量置于高斯值以上六个标准误处。
AI.conclusion: 该构造是一套针对 Lindblad 生成元的 Feynman 规则，其可解部分为开放高斯系统；其范围与限制来自同一结构事实。方法依赖标签格在少量固定基本移动下的闭合，传播子可加性是高斯传播子族的便利而非条件。适用条件为：生成元分成高斯部分与弱非线性且 $U|α|^2$ 相对线宽较小；高斯部分涉及多模式以致密度矩阵不可直接处理；所需量为二阶矩以上的关联子，高斯闭合按构造即错误；耦合足够弱使在所计算阶数上级数仍在改善。自然适用域是稳态附近的小偏离，并要求可观测量和初态在相应本征基中的展开较短；非对角化漂移矩阵和同时作用于两个扇区的跳跃算符是失效情形。Kerr 级数为渐近级数，需在给定阶数引用并与可得的精确结果比较；更强耦合下需要 Borel 或 Padé 重求和。取 $t_0→−∞$ 预设微扰系统与未微扰系统具有相同数目的稳态，否则须另行选支。强非线性、仅需强度或小环中等耦合时，其他方法可能更合适或更经济。
innovations: 提出一套在量子光学算符语言中针对 Lindblad 主方程的 Feynman 规则，将展开分为由本征算符位移代数决定的运动学部分和仅经由未微扰生成元预解式进入的动力学部分。
给出缀饰线方案，使强驱动二能级原子的级数在深进入饱和区仍准确，并表明 Kerr 环和链在固定微扰阶下代价随格点数呈多项式增长。
将规则推广到计数场倾斜生成元以计算无序八格点链的光子计数累积量，并在三格点环上恢复高斯累积量闭合所缺失的非高斯三光子关联部分。

title: Quantum Circuit Pruning: From NISQ Architectures to Fault-Tolerant Operations
summary: We present a routing-aware pruning strategy for quantum circuits that selectively removes parametric two-qubit gates whose computational contribution is outweighed by the fidelity cost of their execution, and assess it across both Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) and fault-tolerant quantum computing (FTQC) architectures. Each two-qubit gate of a circuit is evaluated by comparing an architecture-independent lower bound on the fidelity cost of omitting the gate against a hardware-specific model for the routing execution cost in each setting. We additionally provide an analytical characterization of the pruning boundary as a function of rotation angle, qubit distance, and hardware noise. Simulations on benchmark circuits demonstrate gate count reductions of up to 48.6% and fidelity improvements of up to 47.7% in the NISQ regime, while a feasibility analysis on FT hardware indicates that pruning is expected to remain relevant across a range of code distances and physical error rates. These results establish routing-aware pruning as a practical and unified compilation strategy across the quantum computing stack.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种面向量子电路的路由感知剪枝策略，该策略有选择地移除那些计算贡献被其执行保真度代价所抵消的参数化两比特门，并在含噪中等规模量子（NISQ）与容错量子计算（FTQC）两类架构上对其进行评估。电路中每个两比特门都通过如下方式评估：将省略该门所带来的保真度代价的一个与架构无关的下界，与各设定下路由执行代价的硬件特定模型进行比较。我们进一步给出了剪枝边界作为旋转角、量子比特距离与硬件噪声函数的解析刻画。在基准电路上的模拟表明，在 NISQ 情形下门数最多减少 48.6%，保真度最多提升 47.7%；而在容错硬件上的可行性分析表明，剪枝预计在一系列码距与物理错误率范围内仍然具有相关性。这些结果确立了路由感知剪枝作为一种贯穿量子计算栈的实用且统一的编译策略。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出路由感知剪枝方法：以与架构无关的、省略参数化门所付保真度代价的下界，与按硬件情形调整的执行代价模型（NISQ 中为 SWAP 插入累积的噪声，晶格手术中为 merge-split 路径上的逻辑错误率）相比较，从而决定是否删除该门；在 NISQ 基准电路模拟中，两比特门数最多减少 48.6%、末态保真度最多提升 47.7%，且改进随电路规模增大而增大；解析刻画表明临界路由距离 d^{*} 同时依赖旋转角 θ 与去极化噪声参数 p_{2}；基于 Stim 与 TQEC 的可行性分析表明剪枝在中等码距与物理错误率下仍具相关性，剪枝窗口随硬件改善而收窄但仍存在。作者据此主张该方法是贯穿量子计算栈的实用且可扩展的编译策略，且无需预先调校近似参数；这些结论主要来自模拟与可行性分析，而非独立实验验证。
innovations: 提出路由感知的量子电路剪枝方法，以与架构无关的保真度代价下界与硬件特定路由执行代价模型相比较，选择性地删除参数化两比特门。
给出剪枝边界随旋转角、量子比特距离与去极化噪声参数的解析刻画，使编译设计者无需模拟即可预判剪枝行为。
在同一框架下同时面向 NISQ 与容错架构（晶格手术）进行评估，并在基准电路模拟中报告门数最多减少 48.6%、保真度最多提升 47.7%。

title: Beyond Feasibility: Finite-Depth Accessibility in Constrained QAOA
summary:
Constraint-preserving mixers keep QAOA within a feasible subspace, but feasibility and global mixer connectivity do not determine which feasible configurations are available to a particular shallow circuit. We study constrained QAOA at the level of the circuit actually executed: a specified feasible initial state, finite depth, and finite schedule of mixer interactions. We define the finite-depth accessible set $R_p(M,x_0)$ and show that the computational-basis support of the ideal QAOA circuit is contained within it. This gives a parameter-independent objective ceiling $f_R^\star=\max_{x\in R_p}f(x)$ and a normalized reachable-quality diagnostic $Q_R$, separating accessible volume from the objective quality contained within it.
  We evaluate this framework using resource-matched block-local XY mixer schedules for constrained portfolio optimization and synthetic block-constrained quadratic problems. Across 207 favorable-tail CVaR QAOA configurations, $Q_R$ shows the strongest association with realized shallow-QAOA performance among the structural diagnostics considered, with Pearson and Spearman correlations of $0.7003$ and $0.8057$; the relationship remains positive under controlled and dependence-aware analyses. The distinction persists across changes in feasible initialization, portfolio size, and objective family.
  A compilation-only study further shows that, for the dense portfolio Hamiltonians considered here, phase-separator routing dominates the compiled two-qubit resource scale, while mixer schedules with comparable compiled two-qubit cost can exhibit markedly different finite-depth accessible quality. These results motivate objective-relevant finite-depth accessibility as a complementary diagnostic for resource-bounded constrained QAOA.

AI.abstract_zh:
保持约束的混合器使QAOA保持在可行子空间内，但可行性和全局混合器连通性并不决定某一特定浅层电路可以使用哪些可行配置。我们在实际执行的电路层面研究约束QAOA：指定的可行初始态、有限深度以及有限的混合器相互作用调度。我们定义有限深度可达集 $R_p(M,x_0)$，并表明理想QAOA电路的计算基支撑包含于其中。这给出一个参数无关的目标上限 $f_R^\star=\max_{x\in R_p}f(x)$ 和一个归一化可达质量诊断 $Q_R$，将可达体积与其中包含的目标质量区分开来。
我们使用资源匹配的块局部XY混合器调度，在约束投资组合优化和合成块约束二次问题上评估该框架。在207个有利尾部CVaR QAOA配置中，在所考虑的结构诊断里，$Q_R$与实现的浅层QAOA性能表现出最强的关联，Pearson和Spearman相关系数分别为$0.7003$和$0.8057$；在受控分析和考虑依赖性的分析下，该关系仍为正。这种区分在可行初始化、投资组合规模和目標函数族改变时仍然存在。
一项仅编译研究进一步表明，对于此处考虑的稠密投资组合哈密顿量，相位分离器路由在编译后的双量子比特资源规模中占主导，而具有可比编译后双量子比特成本的混合器调度可以表现出显著不同的有限深度可达质量。这些结果促使将目标相关的有限深度可达性作为资源受限约束QAOA的补充诊断。
AI.conclusion: 在作者所测试的浅层约束QAOA设置中，可行初始态、有限深度和有限混合器相互作用调度共同决定有限深度可达集；该集合为理想电路提供参数无关的目标上限，而 $Q_R$ 刻画可达区域内的目标质量。资源控制实验显示，执行交互预算相近的调度仍可暴露显著不同的可达区域，较大的可达体积不保证更好的目标值；在所考虑的有利尾部CVaR投资组合和合成块约束二次实验中，$Q_R$ 是与实现浅层QAOA性能关联最强的结构诊断，但不能据此认为 $Q_R$ 决定变分性能，也不能认为某种混合器分配策略普遍最优。结论适用于所测试的浅层电路与问题设置；可行性保持和全局连通性不足以回答有限交互预算下实际有限深度电路结构上可用的可行配置及其目标质量是否值得到达。
innovations: 定义有限深度可达集 $R_p(M,x_0)$，并给出理想QAOA电路计算基支撑包含于其中的结构关系。
导出参数无关目标上限 $f_R^\star=\max_{x\in R_p}f(x)$ 与归一化可达质量诊断 $Q_R$，用于区分可达体积和其中的目标质量。
通过资源匹配的块局部XY混合器调度实验和仅编译分析，将目标相关有限深度可达性用于评估资源受限约束QAOA，并区分算法可达性与编译硬件成本。

title: Negative quasiprobabilities redistribute (and complex ones reduce) the information in unabsorbed photons
summary: Negative Kirkwood--Dirac quasiprobabilities are credited with the quantum advantage of interaction-free measurement and postselected metrology. We test that claim on the task interaction-free measurement was designed for: learning about a sample letting it absorb as little light as possible. The Kirkwood--Dirac distribution of path and output gives the linear response to a weak sample: its real part responds to absorption, its imaginary part to a phase. For a pure single photon passing once through any interferometer, the Fisher information about transmittance per absorbed photon is the direct-transmission value minus a sum of squared imaginary parts: no interferometer or readout beats direct transmission. Negativity plays no role beyond concentrating information in weakly lit outputs. The imaginary parts of the Kirkwood-Dirac distribution depend on the output basis here, not on the sample, so a basis exists in which every term is real, which is optimal. A single photon gains information per absorbed photon only through a phase response, which for an optical line needs a thick or inhomogeneously broadened sample, or through many passes when absorptions go uncounted, as shown by a critically coupled resonator. For detecting a weak absorber, negativity gives a single-shot advantage that does not accumulate over multiple trials; advantage instead accumulates when there are outputs which are dark without the object, a case which needs no negativity.

AI.abstract_zh: 负的 Kirkwood--Dirac 准概率被认为带来了无相互作用测量和后选择计量的量子优势。我们在无相互作用测量最初设计用于的任务上检验这一主张：在让样品吸收尽可能少的光的情况下了解样品。路径与输出的 Kirkwood--Dirac 分布给出对弱样品的线性响应：其实部响应吸收，虚部响应相位。对于纯单光子一次通过任意干涉仪，每吸收光子关于透射率的 Fisher 信息等于直接透射值减去虚部平方之和：没有干涉仪或读出能超过直接透射。负性除了把信息集中到弱光输出之外不起作用。这里 Kirkwood-Dirac 分布的虚部依赖于输出基，而不依赖于样品，因此存在一个使每一项都为实数的基，而这是最优的。单光子只有通过相位响应才能获得每吸收光子的信息，而对光学谱线这需要厚样品或非均匀展宽样品；或者当吸收未被计数时通过多次通过获得信息，如临界耦合谐振腔所示。对于探测弱吸收体，负性给出一种单次优势，但它不会在多次试验中累积；相反，当存在无物体时即为暗的输出时，优势会累积，而这种情况不需要负性。
AI.conclusion: 作者结论认为，对于估计样品吸收强度，Kirkwood--Dirac 负性并不是无相互作用测量“每吸收光子信息更高”的资源：负性从总信息中抵消，只在不同输出之间重新分配信息，把信息集中到弱光输出；虚部和输入失相干会进一步减少总信息。单次通过的单光子只有在相位响应（例如光学厚或非均匀展宽样品）下，或在吸收未被登记的多通情形下，才可能获得每吸收光子的信息增益。对于弱吸收体的检测，负性只带来不随多次试验累积的单次优势；可累积的优势来自无物体时为暗的输出（零端口）。这些结论主要针对纯单光子、固定安排以及按每吸收光子归一化等设定，作者也明确指出多光子、压缩态或路径纠缠态等情形未被覆盖。
innovations: 作者论证：纯单光子一次通过任意干涉仪时，每吸收光子的透射率 Fisher 信息不超过直接透射，Kirkwood--Dirac 负性只重新分配信息而不增加总信息。
作者指出 Kirkwood--Dirac 分布的虚部依赖输出基而非样品，因而存在全实且最优的读出基；虚部与失相干会降低总信息。
作者区分检测与估计：负性至多给出不累积的单次检测优势，可累积的优势来自无物体时暗的零端口，而非负性。

title: esQueranto: Differentiable Structured Quantum Light for Automated Scientific Discovery
comment: 19 pages, 10 figures. Software and examples available at https://github.com/artificial-scientist-lab/esQueranto
summary: Uncovering new phenomena in nature requires experiments. For centuries, their design has been exclusively a human endeavor. Today, a new paradigm is emerging in which artificial intelligence and computational methods can design experiments themselves. Realizing this form of automated scientific discovery requires simulators that are sufficiently expressive to represent the diverse physical processes and couplings from which new experiments can be constructed. In this direction, we introduce \textsc{esQueranto}, a differentiable software that brings photon-number quantum optics and structured-light propagation into a common description, allowing the spatial evolution of light to directly influence non-classical quantum states and their interference. \textsc{esQueranto} is implemented in JAX, providing automatic differentiation and hardware-accelerated evaluation for optimization and automated search. We demonstrate the framework across a broad range of quantum-optical applications that exercise complementary aspects of its physical description. By combining quantum and structured-light physics within a single differentiable simulator, \textsc{esQueranto} takes an important step towards the dream of a foundational simulator in physics.

AI.abstract_zh: 揭示自然中的新现象需要实验。几个世纪以来，实验设计一直是人类独有的工作。如今，一种新范式正在出现：人工智能和计算方法可以自行设计实验。实现这种自动化科学发现，需要足够具有表达能力的模拟器，以表示可用于构建新实验的多样物理过程和耦合。为此，我们引入 \textsc{esQueranto}，一种可微软件，它将光子数量子光学和结构光传播纳入共同描述，使光的空间演化能够直接影响非经典量子态及其干涉。\textsc{esQueranto} 在 JAX 中实现，提供自动微分和硬件加速评估，以用于优化和自动搜索。我们在一系列广泛的量子光学应用中演示该框架，这些应用检验了其物理描述的互补方面。通过将量子和结构光物理结合在一个单一的可微模拟器中，\textsc{esQueranto} 朝着物理学基础模拟器之梦迈出了重要一步。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出 esQueranto 是一个用于在共同计算语言中描述和优化量子光学实验的可微框架。该工作将光子数动力学、压缩、条件测量、混合态演化、空间传播和结构干涉结合在同一模拟中，并连接到实验相关目标；其适用范围主要是量子光学实验的描述与优化。作者同时提出未来将这一描述扩展到量子光学之外，长期目标是构建可把日益不同的物理领域组合并优化的基础模拟器。
innovations: 作者提出将光子数量子光学与结构光传播纳入单一可微描述，使光的空间演化直接影响非经典量子态及其干涉。
作者在 JAX 中实现该框架，以提供自动微分和硬件加速评估，用于优化与自动搜索。
作者在多种量子光学应用中演示该框架，涵盖其物理描述的互补方面。

title: Conditioning on Subalgebras - Entropy Duality and Generalized Quantum Stein's Lemma in von Neumann Algebras
summary: We establish duality relations for conditional entropies relative to subalgebras of arbitrary von Neumann algebras, including the Umegaki relative entropy as well as the sandwiched- and Petz-Rényi divergences. Even in finite dimensions, these results extend the familiar dualities for conditional entropies from tensor-product subsystems to general subalgebras, while also lifting the framework to the fully infinite-dimensional setting. As an application, we establish an infinite-dimensional extension of quantum Stein's lemma when the alternative hypothesis is the state space of a finite-index subalgebra, which gives an operational interpretation of the relative entropy to a subalgebra as the optimal asymptotic error exponent in composite quantum hypothesis testing-the first beyond finite dimensions.

AI.abstract_zh: 我们建立了相对于任意冯·诺依曼代数子代数的条件熵的对偶关系，包括 Umegaki 相对熵以及夹心（sandwiched）Rényi 散度和 Petz-Rényi 散度。即使在有限维情形下，这些结果也将条件熵的熟悉对偶关系从张量积子系统推广到一般子代数，同时将框架提升到完全无限维的设置。作为一个应用，当备择假设是有限指数子代数的状态空间时，我们建立了量子 Stein 引理的无限维扩展，这给出了到子代数的相对熵作为复合量子假设检验中最优渐近误差指数的操作解释——这是有限维之外的首次。
AI.conclusion: 现有材料仅提供摘要，未给出正文结论；摘要表明，作者建立了相对于任意冯·诺依曼代数子代数的条件熵对偶关系，并将其应用于有限指数子代数作为备择假设时的无限维量子 Stein 引理，从而给得到子代数的相对熵提供复合量子假设检验中的操作解释。适用范围包括一般子代数及无限维设置，但尚需正文进一步验证。
innovations: 建立相对于任意冯·诺依曼代数子代数的条件熵对偶关系，涵盖 Umegaki 相对熵以及夹心 Rényi 散度和 Petz-Rényi 散度。
将有限维中条件熵的对偶关系从张量积子系统推广到一般子代数，并提升到完全无限维设置。
作者称建立了备择假设为有限指数子代数状态空间时的无限维量子 Stein 引理扩展，并称这是有限维之外的首次。

title: Real-Time Adaptive Filtering and the Boxcar Limit in Superconducting Qubit Readout
summary:
In dispersive readout of superconducting qubits, the common baseline is a boxcar averager: a uniformly weighted average over a fixed window followed by threshold-based state assignment. We ask when additional digital processing improves fidelity. We evaluated an adaptive finite-impulse-response (FIR) filter trained in real time by the least-mean-squares (LMS) algorithm on an FPGA quantum controller, and analyzed measured readout shots offline to compare the frozen filter with boxcar averaging and to test per-sample weighting and sequential detection.
  For the fixed FIR filters tested, summing the filtered samples gives the boxcar sum multiplied by one complex number, apart from a small edge correction (the kernel collapse). This scales state separation and noise equally, so discrimination cannot improve (the boxcar limit).
  The frozen LMS filter reduces trace noise without a resolved fidelity improvement at the tested readout lengths. Replayed on the same shots offline, each filtered shot carries 99.4% of the boxcar shot's discrimination signal-to-noise ratio at the 8 $μ$s operating point of the 2D transmon qubit (Q1).
  On Q1, optimizing the readout window's start and duration improves contrast readout fidelity by +2.4% to +5.6% across four readout lengths. Per-sample weighting adds up to +3.0% over full-window integration, and only +0.33% beyond the tuned window at 8 $μ$s.
  Remaining results are from a 3D ancilla qubit (Q2), which sits above the early-decision crossover that Q1 sits below. Hardware sweeps locate the crossover window near 1 $μ$s. Offline, the sequential test decided most shots early, with fidelity within 0.5 percentage points of the boxcar. About 30 labeled shots per class build a matched-filter template nearly as good as one from hundreds.
  The results form an operating-point record that separates waveform denoising from decision improvement.

AI.abstract_zh:
在超导量子比特的色散读出中，常见基线是箱车平均器：在固定窗口上进行均匀加权平均，随后基于阈值进行状态分配。我们追问：额外的数字处理何时能提高保真度。我们在FPGA量子控制器上评估了一种由最小均方（LMS）算法实时训练的自适应有限脉冲响应（FIR）滤波器，并离线分析测得的读出采样，以将冻结滤波器与箱车平均进行比较，并测试逐样本加权和顺序检测。

对于所测试的固定FIR滤波器，对滤波后样本求和得到的是箱车和乘以一个复数，除一个小的边缘修正（核坍缩）外。这会同等缩放态分离和噪声，因此判别无法改善（箱车极限）。

冻结的LMS滤波器降低了迹线噪声，但在所测试的读出长度下没有分辨出的保真度改善。在相同采样上离线重放时，在2D transmon量子比特（Q1）的8 $μ$s工作点，每个滤波采样携带箱车采样判别信噪比的99.4%。

在Q1上，优化读出窗口的起始和持续时间使对比度读出保真度在四个读出长度上提高+2.4%至+5.6%。逐样本加权在全窗口积分上最多增加+3.0%，而在8 $μ$s下超出调谐窗口仅增加+0.33%。

其余结果来自3D辅助量子比特（Q2），它位于Q1所处的早期决策交叉点之上。硬件扫描将交叉窗口定位在约1 $μ$s。离线时，顺序检验对大多数采样提前判决，保真度在箱车的0.5个百分点以内。每类约30个标记采样构建的匹配滤波模板几乎与数百个标记采样构建的模板一样好。

这些结果形成了一份工作点记录，将波形去噪与判决改善分开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作考察额外数字处理能否在完整窗口积分和调谐箱车积分之外改善超导量子比特读出。片上滤波器按预期从每次单次测量迹线中去除了一定量的噪声，但更干净的迹线并未带来更好的状态分配。对于冻结FIR后接均匀累加的情形，累加输出是箱车统计量乘以一个复数（除有限记录和算术修正外）；该复数由系数及其训练方式决定，并同等缩放态分离和噪声，即作者所称的箱车极限。相同采样重放显示，在Q1保留的四个工作点上，64抽头LMS/Wiener系数相对完整窗口箱车积分没有分辨出的保真度改善；窗口位置和逐样本加权带来了冻结滤波器未能产生的增益。在Q2上，基于模型的模板估计比直接平均减少89.8%的标记模板采样；离线顺序重放的平均判决时间为1.80 $μ$s（占2.60 $μ$s窗口的69.2%），部分划分满足0.5个百分点的保真度等价标准，另一划分则显示分辨出的下降。作者指出，箱车极限适用于所测试的冻结FIR加累加器路径，而非一般线性读出处理；后续架构需直接控制判决权重和分配时间，并需硬件验证保真度约束及测试漂移触发重校准。
innovations: 提出并实验刻画“箱车极限”：在所测试的固定FIR滤波器后接均匀累加时，输出等效为箱车统计量乘以一个复数，同等缩放态分离与噪声，因此不能改善判别。
在FPGA量子控制器上实时训练自适应LMS FIR滤波器，并通过相同采样离线重放评估，发现其降低迹线噪声但在Q1测试工作点未产生分辨出的保真度改善。
通过优化读出窗口起始与持续时间以及逐样本加权获得读出保真度增益，并展示基于模型的模板估计可显著减少标记样本需求、离线顺序检测可缩短平均判决时间。

title: Remote state preparation of a single-spin state via hybrid spin-photon entanglement
summary: Remote state preparation is a fundamental quantum-information protocol that exploits prior knowledge of a target state to reduce the communication resources required for quantum-state distribution. Here, we propose a remote-state-preparation protocol for a stationary electron-spin qubit using hybrid entanglement between the electron spin and a coherent-state light pulse, generated by spin-dependent reflection from a spin-cavity system. Unlike single-photon encodings, the coherent-state encoding is naturally tolerant of photon loss: a loss channel attenuates the coherent-state amplitude, leading to a gradual reduction in preparation fidelity rather than probabilistic protocol failure. The central difficulty---implementing the projection onto superpositions of nonorthogonal coherent states required in the conventional protocol---is circumvented by coupling the transmitted pulse to an auxiliary spin, followed by homodyne detection and a spin projective measurement. The protocol therefore avoids direct coherent-state-superposition measurements and photon-number-resolving detection. In the ideal limit, deterministic preparation of a particular class of target states can be achieved using only one bit of classical communication. We analytically quantify the effects of coherent-state nonorthogonality, fiber loss, and spin dephasing on the preparation fidelity. Increasing the coherent-state amplitude improves state distinguishability and hence the preparation fidelity, but also enhances which-branch information leakage caused by photon loss, resulting in an optimal amplitude at each transmission distance. For experimentally relevant parameters, the optimized average fidelity remains well above the classical benchmark over distances of tens of kilometers. We also discuss a possible implementation using diamond nitrogen-vacancy centers.

AI.abstract_zh: 远程态制备是一种基本量子信息协议，它利用对目标态的先验知识来减少量子态分发所需的通信资源。在此，我们提出一种针对静止电子自旋量子比特的远程态制备协议，利用电子自旋与相干态光脉冲之间的混合纠缠；该纠缠由自旋-腔系统中的自旋相关反射产生。与单光子编码不同，相干态编码天然容忍光子损耗：损耗信道会衰减相干态振幅，导致制备保真度逐渐降低，而不是使协议概率性失败。传统协议中需要对非正交相干态的叠加进行投影，这一核心困难通过将传输脉冲耦合到辅助自旋、随后进行零差探测和自旋投影测量来规避。因此，该协议避免了直接的相干态叠加测量和光子数分辨探测。在理想极限下，仅使用一比特经典通信即可实现某一类目标态的确定性制备。我们解析地量化了相干态非正交性、光纤损耗和自旋退相对制备保真度的影响。增大相干态振幅可提高态的可区分性，从而提高制备保真度，但也会增强由光子损耗引起的“哪一分支”信息泄漏，从而在每个传输距离下存在一个最优振幅。对于实验相关参数，优化后的平均保真度在数十公里距离上仍远高于经典基准。我们还讨论了使用金刚石氮-空位中心的一种可能实现。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出并分析了一种基于离散变量自旋与连续变量光相干态混合纠缠的静止电子自旋远程态制备协议。该协议利用自旋-腔系统的自旋相关反射产生混合资源，在接收端通过辅助自旋、零差探测和目标态相关的投影测量完成所需的光学子系统投影，从而避免直接测量非正交相干态叠加；在理想极限下，对特定类目标态可实现确定性制备，仅需一比特经典通信。分析表明，纯损耗信道只衰减传输脉冲而不会概率性擦除信道，并给出了相干态非正交性、光纤损耗和自旋退相的影响；在实验可行参数下，优化平均保真度在数十公里范围内保持在3/4经典基准之上。上述结论来自理论分析与参数评估，未报道实验验证。
innovations: 提出基于电子自旋与相干态光脉冲混合纠缠的静止电子自旋远程态制备协议。
通过将传输脉冲耦合到辅助自旋并结合零差探测与自旋投影测量，规避对非正交相干态叠加的直接测量和光子数分辨探测。
采用相干态编码使纯损耗仅衰减脉冲幅度而非概率性擦除信道，并解析量化非正交性、光纤损耗与自旋退相的影响及最优振幅。

title: Neural Fourier Surrogates for Data Reuploading Quantum Neural Networks
summary: For quantum machine learning, the exact boundary between classical and quantum advantage is still poorly understood. Direct comparison between quantum neural networks (QNNs) and existing classical models, which encompass fundamentally different function classes, often fails to provide broader insight into the difference between the two. Inspired by the techniques of Neural Quantum States and Random Fourier Features, this work introduces Neural Fourier Surrogates (NFS), a stochastic classical neural network architecture for efficiently learning coefficients over the same finite Fourier series support as quantum neural networks. Testing on a selection of tabular benchmark datasets, we find that NFS is an effective classifier architecture broadly competitive with established classical baselines, including a comparable Random Fourier Features model, and possessing comparable performance to data-reuploading QNNs; combined with additional analysis comparing the learned Fourier spectra of QNNs and NFS on synthetic data, these results establish NFS as a natural classical baseline for evaluating QNN performance.

AI.abstract_zh: 在量子机器学习中，经典优势与量子优势之间的确切边界仍未被充分理解。量子神经网络（QNN）与现有经典模型涵盖根本不同的函数类，直接比较二者往往无法更广泛地揭示两者之间的差异。受神经量子态（Neural Quantum States）和随机傅里叶特征（Random Fourier Features）技术的启发，本文提出神经傅里叶代理模型（Neural Fourier Surrogates, NFS）：一种随机经典神经网络架构，用于高效学习与量子神经网络相同的有限傅里叶级数支撑集上的系数。在一组表格基准数据集上进行测试后，我们发现 NFS 是一种有效的分类器架构，总体上与既有经典基线具有竞争力，包括一个可比的随机傅里叶特征模型，并且与数据重上传 QNN 的性能相当；结合在合成数据上对 QNN 与 NFS 所学傅里叶谱的额外分析，这些结果确立了 NFS 作为评估 QNN 性能的自然经典基线。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出 NFS 作为一种随机经典神经网络架构，可学习与数据重上传 Hamiltonian 编码 QNN 相同类型的复有限傅里叶级数系数；其系数空间在理论上覆盖整个 QNN 函数类，但略大于典型 QNN 架构可达范围。基于 transformer 的模型在中小型表格数据集上表现出与 QNN 相似、与经典基线具有竞争力但并非优于经典基线的性能。因此，NFS 被视为评估 QNN 性能的有力经典基线，有助于理解机器学习中经典与量子优势的边界；作者提出未来可与在量子硬件上执行的 QNN 进行比较，并探索高效循环神经网络以在不牺牲准确率的情况下改善 NFS 的扩展成本。上述结论主要适用于论文测试的中小型表格数据集及相应合成数据分析，未给出更广泛任务上的结论。
innovations: 提出神经傅里叶代理模型（NFS），一种用于学习与数据重上传 QNN 相同有限傅里叶级数支撑集上系数的随机经典神经网络架构。
使用基于 transformer 的模型在中小型表格数据集上展示 NFS 与 QNN 性能相近，并与经典基线具有竞争力。

title: Beyond IP = PSPACE and QIP = PSPACE: Interactive Proofs in Arbitrary Physical Theories
summary: The equalities IP = PSPACE and QIP = PSPACE, the latter achievable with three messages, raise a basic question: how much of an interactive proof's power comes from the underlying physical theory? We study interactive proofs in general probabilistic theories, which include classical and quantum theory. The answer depends on what the prover and verifier exchange and how the theory specifies efficient operations. When they exchange only classical messages, protocols in every theory satisfying our standard assumptions decide exactly PSPACE. For protocols with a quantum verifier and quantum messages, allowing a prover to use any theory containing quantum theory does not increase the maximum acceptance probability. Thus, the three-message PSPACE result remains valid against such provers. When messages may be arbitrary systems, the interactive-proof class can strictly exceed PSPACE.

AI.abstract_zh: 等式 IP = PSPACE 与 QIP = PSPACE（后者可用三条消息实现）提出了一个基本问题：交互式证明的能力有多大程度来自其底层的物理理论？我们研究一般概率理论中的交互式证明，这类理论包含经典理论和量子理论。答案取决于证明者与验证者交换什么，以及该理论如何规定高效操作。当他们只交换经典消息时，在满足我们标准假设的每一种理论中，协议所判定的类恰好是 PSPACE。对于具有量子验证者和量子消息的协议，允许证明者使用任何包含量子理论的理论，并不会提高最大接受概率。因此，三条消息的 PSPACE 结果对此类证明者仍然成立。当消息可以是任意系统时，交互式证明类可以严格超过 PSPACE。
AI.conclusion: 在满足 (T1)–(T4) 的一般概率理论中，若证明者与验证者仅交换经典消息，则交互式证明类为 PSPACE（包括 public-coin 子类）；若验证者为量子电路且消息为量子寄存器，则含量子理论的任意证明者理论不提高接受概率，且 GIP_qm(G;k)=QIP(k)、GIP_qm(G)=PSPACE，并特化回 IP=PSPACE 与 QIP=QIP(3)=PSPACE。若消息可为任意系统，交互式证明类可严格超过 PSPACE；在可计算 v_T 下可无条件分离，见证属于 DSPACE(2^{O(log^2 n)})。对任意消息的 PSPACE 上界需要把消息状态空间与门坐标联系起来的额外假设；对 boxworld 等理论是否等于 PSPACE 尚未确定。
innovations: 将交互式证明置于满足 (T1)–(T4) 的一般概率理论中，并按经典消息、量子消息与任意消息系统分类其证明能力。
证明仅交换经典消息时所有此类理论的 GIP_cl(G) 均为 PSPACE；量子验证者与量子消息下任意含量子理论的证明者不提高最大接受概率，且 GIP_qm(G;k)=QIP(k)。
给出消息为任意系统时交互式证明类严格超过 PSPACE 的构造，并在可计算 v_T 情形得到无条件分离及 DSPACE(2^{O(log^2 n)}) 的见证。

title: From Steane to A7: Quantum Codes from Invariant States
summary:
We construct a two-parameter family of single-error-correcting seven-ququart codes with transversal $\tilde{A_7}$ symmetry, realizing the finite component of a two-qubit super-golden gate set. These $((7,4,3))_4$ codes encode two logical qubits and support non-Clifford operations by applying the same gate to each physical ququart.
  Our method constructs invariant parent states rather than searching directly for a codespace. For $n$ systems of local dimension $q$, suppose the local symmetry is a unitary $t$-group and the permutation symmetry is $t$-transitive. Maximal mixing of all marginals on at most $t$ sites is then equivalent to linear equations in Schur--Weyl sector weights. Every feasible solution yields parents of pure distance at least $t+1$; puncturing one site produces a $q$-dimensional code of distance at least $t$ with the prescribed local symmetry acting transversally.
  Steane and the nonstabilizer Fake Steane code reveal why the construction leaves continuous freedom. They share the same prescribed transversal Clifford and permutation symmetries, and their eight-qubit purifications lie on a circle: error correction fixes two invariant-sector norms but leaves the relative phase free. Keeping the same permutation group and replacing Clifford symmetry by $\tilde{A_7}$ $\leq SU(4)$ gives three fixed sector norms and two free relative phases, producing the new ququart family.

AI.abstract_zh:
我们构造了一个双参数族的单错误校正七量子四进制码（seven-ququart codes），其具有横向 $\tilde{A_7}$ 对称性，实现了两量子比特超黄金门集的有限分量。这些 $((7,4,3))_4$ 码编码两个逻辑量子比特，并通过对每个物理量子四进制（ququart）施加相同门来支持非 Clifford 操作。
我们的方法构造不变母态，而不是直接搜索码空间。对于 $n$ 个局域维数为 $q$ 的系统，假设局域对称性是一个酉 $t$-群，置换对称性是 $t$-重传递的。那么，至多 $t$ 个位点上所有边缘的最大混合等价于 Schur--Weyl 扇区权重中的线性方程。每个可行解都产生纯距离至少为 $t+1$ 的母态；删除一个位点会产生一个距离至少为 $t$ 的 $q$ 维码，且规定的局域对称性横向作用。
Steane 码和非稳定子 Fake Steane 码揭示了该构造为何留下连续自由度。它们共享相同的规定横向 Clifford 对称性和置换对称性，而其八量子比特纯化位于一个圆上：纠错固定两个不变扇区范数，但使相对相位保持自由。保持相同的置换群并将 Clifford 对称性替换为 $\tilde{A_7}$ $\leq SU(4)$，会得到三个固定的扇区范数和两个自由的相对相位，从而产生新的 ququart 族。
AI.conclusion: 摘要报告：通过构造不变母态而非直接搜索码空间，可在给定局域酉 $t$-群与 $t$-重传递置换对称下，由 Schur--Weyl 扇区权重的线性方程获得纯距离至少 $t+1$ 的母态，删除一个位点可得到距离至少 $t$ 的 $q$ 维码；据此构造出具有横向 $\tilde{A_7}$ 对称性的单错误校正七 ququart 双参数码族，可编码两个逻辑量子比特并支持非 Clifford 操作。该结论限于摘要所述的构造与理论分析，未给出独立验证或具体应用评估。
innovations: 提出构造不变母态而非直接搜索码空间的方法。
将最大边缘混合条件转化为 Schur--Weyl 扇区权重的线性方程，并由此得到纯距离至少 $t+1$ 的母态。
构造出具有横向 $\tilde{A_7}$ 对称性的单错误校正七 ququart 双参数码族，并用 Steane 与 Fake Steane 码说明连续自由度的来源。

title: A Quantum Phase Neural Network with Multi-Inputs/Single-Output
summary: A 35 input/single output quantum phase neural network (QPNN) is proposed to recognize the English letters' A 'and' B 'composed 7*5 of pixels. Each node of the proposed QPNN has the input with 0 or 1. Through normalization and quantum phase encoding, each set of 35 with 0 or 1 digital inputs is encoded into a quantum superposition state described by 35 quantum phases. Then, a quantum rotation gate is used to introduce adjustable phase, and a controlled NOT gate is used to entangle the relative phase between the two inputs. The relationship between the input and output of the network is derived. This paper also derived the phase weight learning training algorithm with adaptive learning rate. The solutions with the recognition probability of 1 is designed, and the analytical expressions for all adjustable phase solutions with zero errors are not unique. The experimental performance is verified on the Qiskit platform. This paper uses phase drive to convert the probability calculation into an analytical polynomial function with adjustable rotation angles in the network, avoiding the bottleneck of generating all 2^35 complex exponential amplitudes and providing an effective way to solve the "exponential wall" problem, which provides a new implementation solution for the practical application of multi-input recognition problems.

AI.abstract_zh: 提出一种 35 输入/单输出的量子相位神经网络（QPNN），用于识别由 7×5 个像素组成的英文字母 A 和 B。所提出 QPNN 的每个节点输入为 0 或 1。通过归一化和量子相位编码，每组 35 个取值为 0 或 1 的数字输入被编码为由 35 个量子相位描述的量子叠加态。然后，使用量子旋转门引入可调相位，并使用受控非门使两个输入之间的相对相位发生纠缠。推导了网络输入与输出之间的关系。本文还推导了具有自适应学习率的相位权重学习训练算法。设计了识别概率为 1 的解，且所有零误差可调相位解的解析表达式并非唯一。在 Qiskit 平台上验证了实验性能。本文利用相位驱动将概率计算转化为网络中具有可调旋转角的解析多项式函数，避免生成全部 2^35 个复指数振幅的瓶颈，为解决「指数墙」问题提供有效途径，并为多输入识别问题的实际应用提供新的实现方案。
AI.conclusion: 据摘要，作者提出并推导了 35 输入/单输出量子相位神经网络的输入-输出关系及带自适应学习率的相位权重训练算法，设计了识别概率为 1 的解，并指出零误差可调相位解的解析表达式不唯一；在 Qiskit 平台上的验证报告了实验性能。摘要称该方法通过相位驱动避免生成全部 2^35 个复指数振幅，为多输入识别问题提供实现方案。上述结论仅由摘要支持，具体有效性与适用范围仍需正文结论节选或独立验证确认。
innovations: 提出一种 35 输入/单输出的量子相位神经网络，用于识别由 7×5 个像素组成的英文字母 A 和 B。
推导了具有自适应学习率的相位权重学习训练算法，并设计识别概率为 1 的解；零误差可调相位解的解析表达式不唯一。
利用相位驱动将概率计算转化为含可调旋转角的解析多项式函数，避免生成全部 2^35 个复指数振幅，为多输入识别问题提供实现方案。

title: A Gate-Based Quantum Computing Framework for Codon Optimization
summary: Codon optimization is a challenging combinatorial optimization problem with important applications in synthetic biology, protein expression, and biotechnology. While quantum annealing has previously been explored for this problem, the application of gate-based quantum algorithms remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present a gate-based quantum computing framework for codon optimization by formulating the optimization objective as an Ising Hamiltonian and expressing it in terms of Pauli operators suitable for gate-based quantum processors. The proposed framework is investigated using the Variational Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), Sampling Variational Quantum Eigensolver (SVQE), and the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), with benchmarking against exact diagonalization, classical optimization, and quantum annealing. Using a three-amino-acid benchmark, the proposed implementations successfully reproduce the exact ground-state solutions while identifying optimized ansatz selections, optimization strategies, initialization schemes, and hardware execution settings that provide reproducible performance on current noisy quantum hardware. Hardware demonstrations are performed on IBM Quantum processors to evaluate the practical implementation of the proposed workflow. As a work in progress, this study establishes a reproducible computational framework for gate-based quantum codon optimization and provides the foundation for future investigations of larger protein sequences as quantum hardware and algorithms continue to advance.

AI.abstract_zh: 密码子优化是一个具有挑战性的组合优化问题，在合成生物学、蛋白质表达和生物技术中具有重要应用。尽管此前已有研究将量子退火用于该问题，但基于门的量子算法的应用在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本工作中，我们提出一种基于门的量子计算框架用于密码子优化：将优化目标表述为伊辛哈密顿量，并用适合基于门的量子处理器的泡利算符表示。所提出的框架使用变分量子特征求解器（VQE）、采样变分量子特征求解器（SVQE）和量子近似优化算法（QAOA）进行研究，并与精确对角化、经典优化和量子退火进行基准比较。使用三氨基酸基准，所提出的实现成功复现了精确基态解，同时识别出优化的拟设选择、优化策略、初始化方案和硬件执行设置，这些设置可在当前含噪量子硬件上提供可复现的性能。在 IBM Quantum 处理器上进行了硬件演示，以评估所提出工作流程的实际实现。作为一项进行中的工作，本研究建立了用于基于门的量子密码子优化的可复现计算框架，并为随着量子硬件和算法持续进步而开展更大蛋白质序列的未来研究提供了基础。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过适合量子计算的伊辛哈密顿量表述，对密码子优化问题的基于门的量子算法进行了初步研究；开发了基于 VQE、SVQE 和 QAOA 的计算流程，并与精确对角化、经典优化和量子退火进行基准比较。在三氨基酸基准上，所有所研究的方法均成功恢复了精确对角化识别出的完整简并基态解集；在 IBM Quantum 处理器上的硬件实验评估了不同执行设置下的 SVQE 和 QAOA，提供了测量次数和误差抑制技术等硬件参数对解质量和基态恢复影响的洞见。作者将其定位为进行中的工作，主要贡献是建立并验证了基于门的量子密码子优化流程，适用于当前含噪硬件和该三氨基酸基准，并为随着硬件和算法成熟而研究更大密码子优化问题提供灵活框架。
innovations: 提出一种基于门的量子计算框架，把密码子优化目标表述为伊辛哈密顿量并写成适合基于门的量子处理器的泡利算符形式。
构建并基准测试了基于 VQE、SVQE 和 QAOA 的计算流程，与精确对角化、经典优化和量子退火进行比较。
建立并验证了可复现的基于门量子密码子优化流程，并在 IBM Quantum 处理器上开展硬件演示。

title: Telecom-Band Optical Transitions of Erbium Atoms in Rare-Gas Solids
summary: Rare-earth (RE) atoms, such as erbium (Er), have inner-shell optical transitions in the near-infrared, some of which are in the telecom bands. These transitions are largely insensitive to the host environment due to effective shielding by the filled outer shells. Cryogenic rare-gas (RG) solids, such as solid neon (Ne) and argon (Ar), combine high chemical purity with a nearly nuclear-spin-free environment, making them attractive solid hosts for preserving optical and spin coherence. In this work, we isolate neutral Er atoms in solid Ne and Ar at 6 K and characterize their emission by steady-state and time-resolved photoluminescence (PL) spectroscopy. In both hosts, we observe several near-infrared transitions between 1000--1500 nm, including inner-shell emission in the telecom O and E bands. The $4f \rightarrow 5d$ transition near 1299 nm forms a multiplet of narrow components, consistent with crystal-field splitting, and decays on a microsecond timescale. The $4f \rightarrow 4f$ transition near 1437 nm shows a matrix shift below 1 cm$^{-1}$ in both hosts. In solid Ne, its inhomogeneous linewidth is bounded by the spectrometer resolution to < 22 GHz, and its PL lifetime reaches up to 78.9 ms, close to the estimated radiative limit. Thermal annealing extends the 1437 nm lifetime in Ne and suppresses the phonon sidebands relative to the zero-phonon lines in Ar. These results identify RG solids as promising hosts for long-lived telecom-band Er emission and provide a foundation for future spin-photon interfaces and hybrid quantum architectures.

AI.abstract_zh: 稀土（RE）原子，例如铒（Er），具有位于近红外的内壳层光学跃迁，其中一些跃迁位于通信波段。由于满外壳层的有效屏蔽，这些跃迁在很大程度上对宿主环境不敏感。低温稀有气体（RG）固体，例如固态氖（Ne）和氩（Ar），兼具高化学纯度和几乎无核自旋的环境，使其成为有望保持光学与自旋相干性的有吸引力的固体宿主。在本工作中，我们在6 K下将中性Er原子隔离在固态Ne和Ar中，并通过稳态与时间分辨光致发光（PL）光谱表征其发射。在两种宿主中，我们观察到若干位于1000--1500 nm之间的近红外跃迁，包括通信O波段和E波段的内壳层发射。约1299 nm附近的$4f \rightarrow 5d$跃迁形成一个由窄组分构成的多重态，与晶体场分裂一致，并在微秒时间尺度上衰减。约1437 nm附近的$4f \rightarrow 4f$跃迁在两种宿主中均表现出低于1 cm$^{-1}$的基质位移。在固态Ne中，其非均匀线宽受光谱仪分辨率限制为< 22 GHz，其PL寿命最高可达78.9 ms，接近估计的辐射极限。热退火延长了Ne中1437 nm的寿命，并相对于Ar中的零声子线抑制了声子边带。这些结果表明RG固体是用于长寿命通信波段Er发射的有前景宿主，并为未来的自旋-光子界面和混合量子架构提供了基础。
AI.conclusion: 作者在6 K下于固态Ne和Ar中隔离中性Er原子，并观测到从可见到通信波段的光发射；光谱可由自由原子能级结构结合多声子弛豫解释，后者将布居引导至大能隙以上的能级。位于通信E波段、1437 nm的屏蔽$4f\rightarrow4f$跃迁L14表现出可忽略的基质位移、窄线，以及在退火Ne中最高约79 ms的寿命，接近估计的辐射极限；位于O波段、1299 nm的5d相关跃迁L13则表现出更强的宿主耦合、晶体场多重态和微秒尺度衰减。退火对两种宿主影响不同：在Ne中形成更均匀、弱淬灭的环境，而在Ar中并非如此。结合稀有气体固体几乎无核自旋的环境，作者认为固态Ne中的Er是长寿命通信波段发射体的有前景平台；这些结论限于所研究的Ne/Ar基质与6 K光谱表征范围。
innovations: 在6 K下将中性Er原子隔离于固态Ne和Ar中，并对其可见至通信波段发射进行稳态与时间分辨PL表征。
观测到1299 nm附近$4f\rightarrow5d$晶体场多重态（微秒衰减）和1437 nm附近$4f\rightarrow4f$窄线；后者基质位移低于1 cm$^{-1}$，在Ne中非均匀线宽<22 GHz、寿命最高78.9 ms。
热退火延长Ne中1437 nm寿命并抑制Ar中声子边带，作者据此提出固态Ne中的Er可作为长寿命通信波段发射平台。

title: TATVA: A Reinforcement Learning Framework for Quantum Circuit Synthesis
summary: One of the most important initial steps in quantum computing is high-fidelity quantum state preparation, because errors in it can affect the final computational result. Therefore, one of the major challenges is to design a quantum circuit that can achieve the desired target state accurately with a smaller number of gates. Traditionally, circuits are designed using predefined rules and mathematical decompositions, but this makes it difficult to design circuits for different and complex target states. This paper presents TATVA, a reinforcement learning (RL) system for synthesizing quantum circuits. TATVA views circuit synthesis as a sequential decision problem in which the agents select one gate at a time and calculate the fidelity after each applied gate, with the gate producing the highest fidelity selected for the circuit. The system introduces a parallel architecture that uses two RL agents, Deep Q-Network (DQN) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), along with Qiskit's statevector simulator. The system can synthesize up to 5 qubits while achieving a fidelity of 0.999999 and producing compact circuits. After achieving the desired fidelity, it performs a post-hoc optimization step that reduces the circuit depth while preserving the achieved fidelity. The circuit is finalized using fidelity, success rate, gate count, and circuit depth. Target states that are not used during training are used to test whether the system has learned effectively and can generalize beyond the training states. This approach aims to enable automatic quantum circuit synthesis with high fidelity using reinforcement learning.

AI.abstract_zh: 量子计算中最重要的初始步骤之一是高保真度量子态制备，因为其中的误差会影响最终计算结果。因此，主要挑战之一是设计一个量子电路，能够以更少的门数准确达到期望的目标态。传统上，电路使用预定义规则和数学分解来设计，但这使得针对不同且复杂的目标态设计电路变得困难。本文提出 TATVA，一个用于合成量子电路的强化学习（RL）系统。TATVA 将电路合成视为一个序贯决策问题，其中智能体每次选择一个门，并在每个门应用后计算保真度，选择产生最高保真度的门加入电路。该系统引入一种并行架构，使用两个 RL 智能体——深度 Q 网络（DQN）和近端策略优化（PPO）——以及 Qiskit 的态矢量模拟器。该系统可合成最多 5 个量子比特，同时达到 0.999999 的保真度并生成紧凑电路。在达到期望保真度后，它执行事后优化步骤，在保持已实现保真度的同时降低电路深度。电路最终依据保真度、成功率、门数和电路深度来确定。训练期间未使用的目标态用于测试系统是否有效学习并能够泛化到训练状态之外。该方法旨在利用强化学习实现高保真度的自动量子电路合成。
AI.conclusion: 作者在正文中总结，TATVA 将态制备表述为按保真度和电路成本增量选门的序贯决策问题，并在 1 至 5 量子比特的基态、叠加态、Bell、GHZ、W 和 Haar 随机目标态上评估。作者报告合成电路一致达到 0.999999 的目标保真度，事后优化在评估案例中将保真度提高到 1.0000000000，并降低门数、CNOT 数和电路深度，多量子比特电路中尤为明显；这些结果支持将强化学习选门与电路级优化结合可产生准确且更紧凑的态制备电路，但结论限于所评估的规模与目标态。
innovations: 将量子电路合成建模为按门增量选择并依据保真度评估的序贯决策问题。
提出并行使用 DQN 与 PPO 两个强化学习智能体并结合 Qiskit 态矢量模拟器的框架，用以对同一目标态比较不同电路生成策略。
在达到目标保真度后加入事后电路优化，以降低门数、CNOT 数和深度并保持保真度。

title: Sublinear-depth Quantum Simulation of Electrons with Atomic Orbitals
summary: Discretizing electronic degrees of freedom into atomic orbitals is the default choice to accurately model electrons in molecules in a compact and flexible way. We consider the task of simulating such electronic structure models on a quantum computer for $N$ orbitals, keeping the number of orbitals per atom constant. Atomic orbitals give rise to Hamiltonians with potentially up to $\mathcal{O}(N^4)$ terms and little structure, which made it challenging to match the complexity of methods based on plane waves and real-space grids. In this work, we show that a Trotter step for atomic orbitals can be implemented in depth $\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{polylog}(N))$ without ancillas by combining a rigorous treatment of orbital localization, a hierarchical Hamiltonian decomposition based on the Fast Multipole Method, and shallow quantum Fourier arithmetic circuits. By bounding the Trotter error, we obtain sublinear simulation depth, and our total gate count $N^{5/3 + o(1)}$ matches the best scaling known for any basis.

AI.abstract_zh: 将电子自由度离散化到原子轨道，是以紧凑且灵活的方式准确模拟分子中电子的默认选择。我们考虑在量子计算机上模拟此类电子结构模型的任务，其中轨道数为 $N$，并保持每个原子的轨道数不变。原子轨道会产生最多包含 $\mathcal{O}(N^4)$ 项且结构较少的哈密顿量，这使得难以匹配基于平面波和实空间网格的方法的复杂度。在这项工作中，我们表明，通过结合对轨道局域化的严格处理、基于快速多极子方法的分层哈密顿量分解以及浅层量子傅里叶算术电路，可以在不使用辅助量子比特的情况下以 $\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{polylog}(N))$ 的深度实现原子轨道的 Trotter 步。通过界定 Trotter 误差，我们获得了亚线性模拟深度，并且我们的总门数 $N^{5/3 + o(1)}$ 与已知任意基底下最佳标度相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，在原子轨道基底下，通过结合轨道局域化的严格处理、基于快速多极子方法的分层哈密顿量分解和浅层量子傅里叶算术电路，可在不使用辅助量子比特的情况下以 $\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{polylog}(N))$ 深度实现 Trotter 步；在界定 Trotter 误差后，作者得到亚线性模拟深度，总门数为 $N^{5/3+o(1)}$，并称其与已知任意基底下最佳标度相匹配。该结论适用于每原子轨道数保持常数、原子轨道哈密顿量最多含 $\mathcal{O}(N^4)$ 项的电子结构模型；摘要未给出具体分子或数值基准验证。
innovations: 提出一种无需辅助量子比特、深度为 $\mathcal{O}(\mathrm{polylog}(N))$ 的原子轨道 Trotter 步实现。
将轨道局域化的严格处理、基于快速多极子方法的分层哈密顿量分解与浅层量子傅里叶算术电路结合。
通过界定 Trotter 误差获得亚线性模拟深度，并给出总门数 $N^{5/3+o(1)}$ 的标度。

title: Exact $T$-counts of Toffoli layers from an isotropy bound
summary: The $T$-count is the dominant cost of fault-tolerant Clifford+$T$ computation. We prove that a layer of $m$ disjoint CCZ gates, the diagonal core of a parallel Toffoli layer, needs exactly $6m+1$ $T$ gates in every Hadamard-free Clifford+$T$ circuit with clean ancillas. Campbell and Howard gave the matching construction. To our knowledge this is the first proof that it is optimal for general $m$ (for $m=1$ the value $7$ is classical, and Campbell and Howard state the value $13$ at $m=2$). On every controlled unitary the same floor comes within one of their exact count, and it recovers their $4m+3$ for a fan-out of $m$ Toffolis from one control. The proof rests on an isotropy constraint: for a pure-cubic phase, the vectors recording which $T$ gates touch each qubit span a totally isotropic subspace. In general the constraint gives the isotropy floor $δ\ge2(n-d^{\ast})-r$ for every diagonal level-three gate, computed from the phase polynomial in polynomial time. The floor is never below stabilizer nullity $ν$, which equals $n-d^{\ast}$ on this class, and a separate parity argument raises it to $2ν+1$ on non-Clifford pure-cubic gates. On the output of the TODD optimizer for the $24$ benchmark circuits it completes, the floor certifies $193$ of its $311$ merged phase-polynomial blocks optimal for their Hadamard layering ($186$ to $193$ across five optimizer seeds), against $113$ for nullity. The floor also holds, under stated conditions, for circuits whose only internal Hadamards form unitarily uncomputed temporary AND blocks, while under adaptive feedforward only $t\geν$ is proved.

AI.abstract_zh: T 门计数是容错 Clifford+T 计算的主导成本。我们证明：一层由 m 个互不相交的 CCZ 门组成（即并行 Toffoli 层的对角核心），在每一个具有干净辅助比特的无 Hadamard Clifford+T 电路中恰好需要 6m+1 个 T 门。Campbell 和 Howard 给出了匹配的构造。据我们所知，这是首个证明其对一般 m 最优的结果（对于 m=1，值 7 是经典的；Campbell 和 Howard 在 m=2 时给出值 13）。对每个受控酉算子，同一个下界与其精确计数相差不超过一，并重新得到他们针对从一个控制位扇出 m 个 Toffoli 的 4m+3。该证明依赖于一个各向同性约束：对于纯三次相位，记录哪些 T 门触及每个量子比特的向量张成一个全各向同性子空间。一般而言，该约束给出各向同性下界 δ≥2(n−d^∗)−r，适用于每个对角三级门，并可由相位多项式在多项式时间内计算。该下界从不低于稳定子零化度 ν；在该类上 ν 等于 n−d^∗，而另一个奇偶性论证在非 Clifford 纯三次门上将其提高到 2ν+1。在 TODD 优化器对其完成的 24 个基准电路输出上，该下界证明其 311 个合并的相位多项式块中有 193 个对其 Hadamard 分层是最优的（在五个优化器种子下为 186 到 193），而零化度证明 113 个。该下界在所述条件下也适用于这样的电路：其唯一的内部 Hadamard 构成被酉地反计算的临时 AND 块；而在自适应前馈下仅证明了 t≥ν。
AI.conclusion: 论文在无 Hadamard 的 Clifford+T 模型（干净辅助比特）中证明 m 个不相交 CCZ 门层恰好需要 6m+1 个 T 门，并给出可由相位多项式多项式时间计算的各向同性下界，在基准上比稳定子零化度认证更多最优块。结论同时指出该下界在带前馈的稳定子操作下不单调，因而可超过限制 CCZ 上每类单调量的、相对零化度的 4/3 因子；代价是界依赖电路模型。补充材料将结果扩展到部分含内部 Hadamard 的电路和更高 Clifford 层级，并说明自适应前馈下仅知零化度成立，遗留若干开放问题。
innovations: 作者称据其所知，这是首个证明 m 个不相交 CCZ 门层的 6m+1 个 T 门数对一般 m 最优的结果。
作者提出基于全各向同性子空间约束的下界 δ≥2(n−d^∗)−r，并说明可由相位多项式在多项式时间内计算。
作者给出独立奇偶性论证，在非 Clifford 纯三次门上将下界提高到 2ν+1。

title: Device-Independent Conference Keys from Parity-Extended Games
summary: Device-independent conference key agreement (DI-CKA) lets a group of parties establish a shared secret key from untrusted quantum devices, with security certified by non-locality. Existing DI-CKA protocols are each built around a single Bell inequality, typically a multiparty variant of the CHSH game. DI-QKD protocols, in contrast, have been built from a much richer landscape of non-local games, and it has remained unclear how to carry this landscape over to the conference setting. We introduce $\textit{Parity-$G$ games}$, which extend any two-player game $G$ to $N$ players, for every $N$, provided $G$ has an optimal strategy in which one player measures Pauli observables. The extension preserves the quantum and classical values of $G$, and the security of the resulting $N$-party protocol follows from an analysis of the two-player game alone. Our framework recovers the Parity-CHSH game of Ribeiro, Murta and Wehner (Phys. Rev. A, 2018) as a special case. Applied to the Mermin--Peres Magic Square Game, it yields a new $N$-player pseudo-telepathy game, the $\textit{Parity Magic Square Game}$, which ideal devices win in every round. We use it to construct the $\textit{first}$ DI-CKA protocol based on a pseudo-telepathy game. We prove the protocol secure against coherent attacks. It produces up to two key bits per round, and at low noise its key rate exceeds that of the DI-CKA protocol based on the Parity-CHSH game.

AI.abstract_zh: 设备无关会议密钥协商（DI-CKA）使一组参与方能够利用不可信量子设备建立共享秘密密钥，其安全性由非局域性保证。现有 DI-CKA 协议各自围绕单个 Bell 不等式构建，通常是 CHSH 博弈的多方变体。相比之下，DI-QKD 协议已经建立在更丰富的非局域博弈图景之上，而如何将这一图景推广到会议场景仍不清楚。我们引入 $\textit{Parity-$G$ games}$，只要 $G$ 具有某一参与方测量 Pauli 可观测量的最优策略，该构造就把任意两方博弈 $G$ 扩展到 $N$ 方，且对每个 $N$ 均适用。该扩展保持 $G$ 的量子值与经典值，且所得 $N$ 方协议的安全性仅由对两方博弈的分析即可推出。我们的框架将 Ribeiro、Murta 和 Wehner（Phys. Rev. A, 2018）的 Parity-CHSH 博弈作为特例恢复出来。将其应用于 Mermin--Peres Magic Square Game，可得到一个新的 $N$ 方伪心灵感应博弈，即 $\textit{Parity Magic Square Game}$，理想设备在每一轮都能获胜。我们用它构造了 $\textit{首个}$ 基于伪心灵感应博弈的 DI-CKA 协议。我们证明该协议对相干攻击安全。它每轮最多产生两个密钥比特，并且在低噪声下其密钥率超过基于 Parity-CHSH 博弈的 DI-CKA 协议。
AI.conclusion: 摘要显示，作者提出 Parity-$G$ 博弈框架，将满足特定 Pauli 最优策略条件的两方博弈扩展到任意 $N$ 方，并保持量子值与经典值，从而使 $N$ 方协议的安全性可归约到两方博弈分析；将其用于 Mermin--Peres Magic Square Game 得到 Parity Magic Square Game，并据此构造基于伪心灵感应博弈的 DI-CKA 协议，声称证明其对抗相干攻击安全，每轮最多产生两个密钥比特，低噪声下密钥率高于基于 Parity-CHSH 的 DI-CKA。上述结论仅来自摘要，未提供正文结论节选或独立验证。
innovations: 引入 Parity-$G$ 博弈，将具有某一参与方测量 Pauli 可观测量的最优策略的任意两方博弈扩展到任意 $N$ 方，并保持其量子值与经典值。
将 Mermin--Peres Magic Square Game 扩展为新的 $N$ 方伪心灵感应博弈 Parity Magic Square Game，理想设备每轮获胜。
作者声称构造了首个基于伪心灵感应博弈的 DI-CKA 协议，证明其对抗相干攻击安全，低噪声下密钥率超过基于 Parity-CHSH 的 DI-CKA。

title: Function-like pseudorandom unitaries generate pseudorandom quantum processes
summary: Haar-random unitaries provide a canonical model of generic random quantum evolution, but they typically have exponential description and circuit complexity. Although pseudorandom unitaries efficiently emulate a single Haar-random unitary, many tasks require an entire reusable family of independently random-looking operations. We introduce pseudorandom function-like unitaries (PRFU), which generate such a family indexed by public labels using only a single short key. We distinguish classical- and coherent-label access and establish security under adaptive quantum queries. For classical labels, we provide a generic construction from a post-quantum pseudorandom function and a pseudorandom unitary. For coherent labels, we use an indexed path-recording framework to analyze interference across labels and prove security of a construction based on quantum-secure function and permutation primitives. We further show that PRFUs generate pseudorandom channels and quantum combs with private memory, which are secure against adaptive interventions and concurrent sessions. Combining PRFUs with unitary gluing yields a one-key family of pseudorandom unitaries whose supported register widths can be chosen after key generation. Further applications include nonce-resolved quantum authentication, coherently masked QRAM queries, and efficient emulation of random multi-time dynamics. Our results extend quantum pseudorandomness from individual operations to efficiently generated families of random-looking quantum dynamics.

AI.abstract_zh: Haar随机酉提供了一般随机量子演化的标准模型，但它们通常具有指数级的描述复杂度和电路复杂度。虽然伪随机酉能够高效模拟单个Haar随机酉，但许多任务需要一整个可复用的、彼此看起来独立的操作族。我们引入伪随机函数型酉（PRFU），它仅使用一个短密钥即可生成由公开标签索引的此类族。我们区分经典标签访问和相干标签访问，并在自适应量子查询下建立安全性。对于经典标签，我们给出由后量子伪随机函数和伪随机酉构成的一般构造。对于相干标签，我们使用带索引的路径记录框架分析跨标签干涉，并证明基于量子安全函数和置换原语的一个构造的安全性。我们进一步证明，PRFU可生成具有私有记忆的伪随机信道和量子梳，这些对象对自适应干预和并发会话是安全的。将PRFU与酉粘合结合，可得到单密钥的伪随机酉族，其支持的寄存器宽度可在密钥生成后选择。进一步应用包括nonce分辨的量子认证、相干掩蔽的QRAM查询，以及随机多时间动力学的高效模拟。我们的结果将量子伪随机性从单个操作扩展到可高效生成的、看起来随机的量子动力学族。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出PRFU框架，用于在单一秘密密钥下生成由公开标签索引的联合伪随机量子操作；对经典标签给出由PRU和后量子PRF提升的一般构造，对相干标签给出基于带索引路径记录分析的具体构造，并将安全性扩展到具有不可访问记忆的量子信道和量子梳。其适用范围包括自适应量子查询以及对整族过程的高效自适应交互；PRU与PRFU在相干标签下的一般提升关系，以及所需可调原位qPRP原语的高效构造，仍待解决。
innovations: 引入伪随机函数型酉（PRFU），用单一短密钥生成由公开标签索引的可复用伪随机酉族，并区分经典标签与相干标签访问、在自适应量子查询下建立安全性。
对经典标签给出由后量子伪随机函数和伪随机酉构成的一般提升构造；对相干标签提出带索引的路径记录框架，并证明基于量子安全函数和置换原语的具体构造的安全性。
证明PRFU可生成具有私有记忆且能抵抗自适应干预和并发会话的伪随机信道与量子梳，并结合酉粘合得到寄存器宽度可在密钥生成后选择的单密钥伪随机酉族。

title: Learned Parallel Bit-Flipping Sequential Belief Propagation Decoding of Quantum LDPC Codes
summary: Quantum low-density parity-check (QLDPC) codes are promising candidates for low-overhead fault-tolerant quantum computation, but their practical use requires fast, low-complexity, and reliable decoders. Belief propagation (BP) is attractive because of its local message-passing structure, yet standard flooding BP often suffers from convergence failures on QLDPC codes due to short cycles, degeneracy, and symmetric decoding trajectories. Learned sequential BP improves convergence by using a reinforcement-learning policy to choose variable-node update orders, but a single learned trajectory can still be sensitive to unfavorable local Pauli decisions. We propose a learned parallel bit-flipping sequential BP decoder with a new quaternary score combining syndrome gain, a quantized Pauli log-likelihood penalty, and Q-table lookahead at hypothetical post-flip states. Our decoder first runs learned sequential BP for a fixed number of iterations. If the syndrome is not satisfied, it constructs quaternary bit-flipping candidates, each corresponding to changing the current Pauli decision of one qubit. The selected candidates initialize independent learned sequential BP continuations from the same decoder state. Since these continuations are independent, they can be executed in parallel, so testing several candidates mainly increases parallel hardware resources rather than sequential decoding latency. Simulations on representative QLDPC codes over the depolarizing channel show that the proposed decoder improves the reliability of learned sequential BP while having a parallel low-latency structure.

AI.abstract_zh: 量子低密度奇偶校验（QLDPC）码是低开销容错量子计算的有前景候选方案，但其实际应用需要快速、低复杂度且可靠的解码器。置信传播（BP）因其局部消息传递结构而具有吸引力，然而标准泛洪BP由于短环、简并性和对称解码轨迹，在QLDPC码上常出现收敛失败。学习式顺序BP通过使用强化学习策略选择变量节点更新顺序来改善收敛性，但单一学习轨迹仍可能对不利的局部Pauli判决敏感。我们提出一种学习式并行比特翻转顺序BP解码器，采用一种新的四元评分，该评分结合了校验子增益、量化的Pauli对数似然惩罚，以及在假设翻转后状态上的Q表前瞻。我们的解码器首先运行固定迭代次数的学习式顺序BP。如果校验子未满足，则构造四元比特翻转候选，每个候选对应于改变一个量子比特当前的Pauli判决。选中的候选从同一解码器状态初始化独立的学习式顺序BP延续。由于这些延续相互独立，它们可以并行执行，因此测试多个候选主要增加并行硬件资源，而不是顺序解码延迟。在去极化信道上对代表性QLDPC码的仿真表明，所提出的解码器提高了学习式顺序BP的可靠性，同时具有并行低延迟结构。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出并仿真验证了一种用于去极化信道下QLDPC码的学习式并行比特翻转顺序BP解码器：它先运行固定迭代次数的RL-S，在校验子未满足时从当前解码器配置构造四元Pauli改变候选，并利用局部校验子增益、软可靠性和RL-S Q表调度信息评分，再通过从同一保存配置出发的独立延续分支并行测试选中的候选。仿真表明该解码器在保持并行低延迟结构的同时提升了学习式顺序BP的可靠性；适用范围为代表性QLDPC码和去极化信道，现有材料未给出更广泛码族或硬件实现下的结论。
innovations: 提出一种学习式并行比特翻转顺序BP解码器，在顺序BP未满足校验子时引入受控搜索多样性。
设计结合校验子增益、量化Pauli对数似然惩罚和Q表前瞻的四元评分，用于筛选Pauli翻转候选。
利用从同一解码器状态出发的独立延续分支并行测试多个候选，使增加候选主要消耗并行资源而非顺序解码延迟。

title: The stationarity test: a framework for learning quantum many-body systems from their thermal states
summary:
The task of learning the Hamiltonian interactions governing a quantum system, given samples of its thermal (or 'Gibbs') states, is a foundational question at the intersection of quantum learning theory and many-body physics. In this paper, we draw connections to the quantum Gibbs sampling literature to introduce a natural learning algorithm we call the stationarity test: which simply "guesses" the Hamiltonian, and measures the rate-of-change of local observables, under the associated detailed-balanced quantum Markov chain [CKG23]. We leverage the stationarity test to address the following applications:
  1. To give the first learning algorithm for the underlying interaction graph, i.e. structure learning, of lattice Hamiltonians at all temperatures, given copies of their Gibbs states.
